title.raw: 卷8 世宗紀 Volume 8 Annals: Shizong (Emperor Xuanwu)

sentences.zh: 世宗宣武皇帝，諱恪，高祖孝文皇帝第二子。

translations.literal: Shizong, Emperor Xuanwu, bore the taboo name Ke; he was Gaozu, Emperor Xiaowen's second son.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong, Emperor Xuanwu, bore the taboo name Ke. He was Gaozu, Emperor Xiaowen's second son.

sentences.zh: 母曰高夫人，初，夢為日所逐，避於牀下，日化為龍，繞己數匝，寤而驚悸，既而有娠。

translations.literal: His mother was Lady Gao. At first she dreamed the sun pursued her; she hid under the bed, and the sun turned into a dragon that coiled around her several times. She awoke in shock, and afterward conceived.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Lady Gao. At first she dreamed the sun pursued her; she hid under the bed, and the sun turned into a dragon that coiled around her several times. She awoke in shock, and afterward conceived.

sentences.zh: 太和七年閏四月，生帝於平城宮。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month of the seventh year of Taihe, the Emperor was born in the Pingcheng palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month of the seventh year of Taihe, the emperor was born in the Pingcheng palace.

sentences.zh: 二十一年正月甲午，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, first month, day jiawu, he was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, in the first month, on the jiawu day, he was installed as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 二十三年夏四月丁巳，即皇帝位于魯陽，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, fourth month of summer, day dingsi, he took the throne at Luoyang and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, in the fourth month of summer, on the dingsi day, he took the throne at Luoyang and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 帝居諒闇，委政宰輔。

translations.literal: The Emperor remained in mourning seclusion and entrusted government to chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor remained in mourning seclusion and entrusted government to chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 五月丙子朔，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingzi, new moon: Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the bingzi day, the new moon, Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，分遣侍臣巡行郡國，問民疾苦，考察守令，黜陟幽明，文武應求、道著丘園者，皆加褒禮。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yimao: attendant officials were dispatched separately to tour provinces and commanderies, inquire into the people's hardships, examine prefects and magistrates, promote the worthy and demote the unworthy; all civil and military men who answered the call and whose conduct was outstanding in reclusion were given enhanced honors.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the yimao day, attendant officials were dispatched separately to tour provinces and commanderies, inquire into the people's hardships, and examine prefects and magistrates, promoting the worthy and demoting the unworthy; all civil and military men who answered the call and whose conduct was outstanding in reclusion were given enhanced honors.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，追尊皇妣曰文昭皇后。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: the deceased empress mother was posthumously honored as Empress Wenzhao.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day the deceased empress mother was posthumously honored as Empress Wenzhao.

sentences.zh: 秋八月戊申，遵遺詔，高祖三夫人已下悉歸家。

translations.literal: Eighth month of autumn, day wushen: following the testamentary edict, all three consorts of Gaozu and below were sent home.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the wushen day, following the testamentary edict, all three consorts of Gaozu and below were sent home.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，宮臣增位一級。

translations.literal: Day guichou: palace officials were promoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day palace officials were promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，南徐州刺史沈陵南叛。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Military Inspector of South Xuzhou Shen Ling defected south.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day Shen Ling, military inspector of South Xuzhou, defected south.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未，鄧至國王像舒彭來朝。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day xinwei: the king of Dengzhi, Xiang Shupeng, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinwei day, Xiang Shupeng, king of Dengzhi, came to court.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，車駕謁長陵。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the imperial carriage visited Changling.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day the imperial carriage visited Changling.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，有事於太廟。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: sacrifice at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day sacrifice was performed at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 十有一月，幽州民王惠定聚眾反，自稱明法皇帝，刺史李肅捕斬之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: the people of Youzhou, Wang Huiding, gathered a crowd and rebelled, styled himself Emperor Mingfa; Inspector Li Su captured and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the people of Youzhou, Wang Huiding, gathered a crowd and rebelled, styling himself Emperor Mingfa; Inspector Li Su captured and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙申，彭城王勰、車騎將軍王肅大破之，斬首萬數。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day bingshen: Prince of Pengcheng Xie and General of Chariots and Cavalry Wang Su greatly defeated them and took heads in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the bingshen day, Xie, Prince of Pengcheng, and Wang Su, general of chariots and cavalry, greatly defeated them and took heads in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 己亥，皇弟恌薨。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the emperor's younger brother Tiao died.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day the emperor's younger brother Tiao died.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅，以北鎮大飢，遣兼侍中楊播巡撫賑恤。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiayin: because of great famine in the northern garrisons, Acting Palace Attendant Yang Bo was sent to tour, comfort, and relieve.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiayin day, because of great famine in the northern garrisons, Yang Bo, acting palace attendant, was sent to tour, comfort, and relieve.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，司徒、彭城王勰進位大司馬，車騎將軍王肅加開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingzi: Minister over the Masses, Prince of Pengcheng Xie was advanced to Grand Marshal; General of Chariots and Cavalry Wang Su was given open office and equipage equal to the Three Directors.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the bingzi day, Xie, minister over the masses and Prince of Pengcheng, was advanced to grand marshal; Wang Su, general of chariots and cavalry, was given open office and equipage equal to the Three Directors.

sentences.zh: 癸未，大陽蠻酋田育丘等率戶內附。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: the Di chieftain of Dayang, Tian Yuqiu, and others led their households inward in submission.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day Tian Yuqiu, Di chieftain of Dayang, and others led their households inward in submission.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，寶卷又遣陳伯之寇淮南。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn: Bao Juan again sent Chen Bozhi to raid Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn Bao Juan again sent Chen Bozhi to raid Huainan.

sentences.zh: 庚子，吐谷渾國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，彭城王勰破伯之於肥口。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yiyou: Prince of Pengcheng Xie defeated Bozhi at Feikou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the yiyou day, Xie, Prince of Pengcheng, defeated Bozhi at Feikou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑，東豫州刺史田益宗破寶卷將吳子陽、鄧元起於長風。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yichou: Inspector of East Yuzhou Tian Yizong defeated Bao Juan's generals Wu Ziyang and Deng Yuanqi at Changfeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the yichou day, Tian Yizong, inspector of East Yuzhou, defeated Bao Juan's generals Wu Ziyang and Deng Yuanqi at Changfeng.

sentences.zh: 齊州民柳世明聚眾反。

translations.literal: The people of Qizhou, Liu Shiming, gathered a crowd and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Qizhou, Liu Shiming, gathered a crowd and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 是歲，十七州大飢，分遣使者開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: That year seventeen provinces suffered great famine; envoys were dispatched separately to open granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That year seventeen provinces suffered great famine; envoys were dispatched separately to open granaries for relief.

sentences.zh: 是冬，島夷蕭衍起兵東下，伐其主蕭寶卷。

translations.literal: That winter the island barbarian Xiao Yan raised troops eastward and attacked his lord Bao Juan.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the island barbarian Xiao Yan raised troops eastward and attacked his lord Bao Juan.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丙申朔，車駕謁長陵。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, day bingshen, new moon: the imperial carriage visited Changling.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the first month of spring, on the bingshen day, the new moon, the imperial carriage visited Changling.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，帝始親政。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: the emperor began to govern in person.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day the emperor began to govern in person.

sentences.zh: 遵遺詔，聽司徒、彭城王勰以王歸第。

translations.literal: Following the testamentary edict, Prince of Pengcheng Xie, Minister over the Masses, was permitted to return to his estate as a prince.
translations.idiomatic: Following the testamentary edict, Xie, Prince of Pengcheng and minister over the masses, was permitted to return to his estate as a prince.

sentences.zh: 太尉、咸陽王禧進位太保，司空、北海王詳為大將軍、錄尚書事。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant, Prince of Xianyang Xi was advanced to Grand Mentor; Minister of Works, Prince of Beihai Xiang was made Grand General and Recorder of the Affairs of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Xi, grand commandant and Prince of Xianyang, was advanced to grand mentor; Xiang, minister of works and Prince of Beihai, was made grand general and recorder of the affairs of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，引見羣臣於太極前殿，告以覽政之意。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: he received the assembled ministers at the Hall before the Grand Ultimate and announced his intention to oversee government.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day he received the assembled ministers at the Hall before the Grand Ultimate and announced his intention to oversee government.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，高麗國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以太保、咸陽王禧領太尉，大將軍、廣陵王羽為司徒。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Grand Mentor, Prince of Xianyang Xi was made to hold additionally the post of Grand Commandant; Grand General, Prince of Guangling Yu was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day Xi, grand mentor and Prince of Xianyang, was made to hold additionally the post of grand commandant; Yu, grand general and Prince of Guangling, was made minister over the masses.

sentences.zh: [2]詔曰：「朕幼承寶曆，艱憂在疚，庶事不親，風化未洽。

translations.literal: [2] An edict said: "We in youth received the imperial succession; sorrow and affliction weigh upon us; we have not personally handled affairs, and customs are not yet harmonized.
translations.idiomatic: [2] An edict said, "We in youth received the imperial succession; sorrow and affliction weigh upon us; we have not personally handled affairs, and customs are not yet harmonized.

sentences.zh: 今始覽政務，義協惟新，思使四方風從率善，可分遣大使，黜陟幽明。

translations.literal: Now we first take up government; righteousness calls for renewal; we wish to make the four quarters follow and universally do good—imperial envoys may be dispatched separately to promote the worthy and demote the unworthy.
translations.idiomatic: Now we first take up government; righteousness calls for renewal; we wish to make the four quarters follow and universally do good—imperial envoys may be dispatched separately to promote the worthy and demote the unworthy.

sentences.zh: 」二月庚午，宿衞之官進位一級。

translations.literal: " Second month, day gengwu: guards of the inner palace were promoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: " In the second month, on the gengwu day, guards of the inner palace were promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未朔，詔曰：「比年以來，連有軍旅，役務既多，百姓彫弊。

translations.literal: Third month, day yiwei, new moon: an edict said: "In recent years campaigns have followed one after another; corvée labor has been many, and the hundred surnames are worn down.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the yiwei day, the new moon, an edict said, "In recent years campaigns have followed one after another; corvée labor has been many, and the hundred surnames are worn down.

sentences.zh: 宜時矜量，以拯民瘼。

translations.literal: The season calls for measured compassion to rescue the people's suffering.
translations.idiomatic: The season calls for measured compassion to rescue the people's suffering.

sentences.zh: 正調之外，諸妨害損民一時蠲罷。

translations.literal: Beyond the regular tax levies, all temporary impositions that harm and injure the people are to be waived at once.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the regular tax levies, all temporary impositions that harm and injure the people are to be waived at once.

sentences.zh: 」[3]辛亥，詔曰：「諸州刺史，不親民事，緩於督察，郡縣稽逋，旬月之間，纔一覽決。

translations.literal: " [3] Day xinhai: an edict said: "Provincial inspectors do not personally attend to the people's affairs; they are slack in supervision; prefectures and counties accumulate arrears—in the space of ten days they barely examine and decide a case.
translations.idiomatic: " [3] On the xinhai day an edict said, "Provincial inspectors do not personally attend to the people's affairs; they are slack in supervision; prefectures and counties accumulate arrears—in the space of ten days they barely examine and decide a case.

sentences.zh: 淹獄久訟，動延時序，百姓怨嗟，方成困弊。

translations.literal: Prolonged imprisonment and long litigation constantly delay the seasons; the hundred surnames groan in complaint and are being reduced to distress.
translations.idiomatic: Prolonged imprisonment and long litigation constantly delay the seasons; the hundred surnames groan in complaint and are being reduced to distress.

sentences.zh: 尚書可明條制，申下四方，令日親庶事，嚴勒守宰，不得因循，寬怠虧政。

translations.literal: The Masters of Writing shall set forth regulations clearly and send them down to the four quarters, ordering daily personal attention to common affairs and strict constraint on prefects and magistrates—they may not follow old habits or be lax and negligent, damaging government.
translations.idiomatic: The Masters of Writing shall set forth regulations clearly and send them down to the four quarters, ordering daily personal attention to common affairs and strict constraint on prefects and magistrates—they may not follow old habits or be lax and negligent, damaging government.

sentences.zh: 」壬戌，詔曰：「治尚簡靜，任貴應事。

translations.literal: " Day renxu: an edict said: "Government values simplicity and stillness; appointment values responding to affairs.
translations.idiomatic: " On the renxu day an edict said, "Government values simplicity and stillness; appointment values responding to affairs.

sentences.zh: 州府佐史，除板稍多，方成損弊，無益政道。

translations.literal: Provincial and prefectural subordinates and clerks—in appointments to office there are somewhat many, which becomes harm and distress and is of no benefit to the path of government.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial and prefectural subordinates and clerks—in appointments to office there are somewhat many, which becomes harm and distress and is of no benefit to the path of government.

sentences.zh: 又京師百司，僚局殷雜，官有閑長者，亦同此例。

translations.literal: Moreover in the capital the hundred offices have crowded departments; where officials have idle supernumeraries, they follow this precedent as well.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover in the capital the hundred offices have crowded departments; where officials have idle supernumeraries, they follow this precedent as well.

sentences.zh: 苟非稱要，悉從蠲省。

translations.literal: If they do not match what is essential, all are to be reduced and cut.
translations.idiomatic: If they do not match what is essential, all are to be reduced and cut.

sentences.zh: 」青、齊、徐、兗四州大飢，民死者萬餘口。

translations.literal: " Qing, Qi, Xu, and Yan provinces suffered great famine; more than ten thousand mouths of the people died.
translations.idiomatic: " Qing, Qi, Xu, and Yan provinces suffered great famine; more than ten thousand mouths of the people died.

sentences.zh: 是月，蕭衍立寶卷弟南康王寶融為主，年號中興，東赴建業。

translations.literal: That month Xiao Yan installed Bao Juan's younger brother, Prince of Nankang Bao Rong, as ruler; era name Zhongxing; he marched east toward Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xiao Yan installed Bao Juan's younger brother, Bao Rong, Prince of Nankang, as ruler, with era name Zhongxing, and marched east toward Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬子，廣陵王羽薨。

translations.literal: Fifth month of summer, day renzi: Prince of Guangling Yu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on the renzi day, Yu, Prince of Guangling, died.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太保咸陽王禧謀反，賜死。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Grand Mentor Prince of Xianyang Xi plotted rebellion and was granted death.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day Xi, grand mentor and Prince of Xianyang, plotted rebellion and was granted death.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥，考諸州刺史，加以黜陟。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dinghai: provincial inspectors were examined and promoted or demoted accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the dinghai day, provincial inspectors were examined and promoted or demoted accordingly.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙巳，蠕蠕犯塞。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day yisi: the Rouran raided the frontier passes.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the yisi day, the Rouran raided the frontier passes.

sentences.zh: 乙未，東豫州刺史田益宗破蕭寶卷將黃天賜於赤亭。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Inspector of East Yuzhou Tian Yizong defeated Bao Juan's general Huang Tiansi at Chiting.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day Tian Yizong, inspector of East Yuzhou, defeated Bao Juan's general Huang Tiansi at Chiting.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，車騎將軍、儀同三司王肅薨。

translations.literal: Day renxu: General of Chariots and Cavalry, Equipage Equal to the Three Directors, Wang Su died.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day Wang Su, general of chariots and cavalry with equipage equal to the Three Directors, died.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，發畿內夫五萬人築京師三百二十三坊，[4]四旬而罷。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingyou: fifty thousand men within the capital districts were levied to build three hundred twenty-three wards of the capital [4]—the work ceased after forty days.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the dingyou day, fifty thousand men within the capital districts were levied to build three hundred twenty-three wards of the capital [4]; the work ceased after forty days.

sentences.zh: 己亥，立皇后于氏。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the empress of the Yu clan was installed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day the empress of the Yu clan was installed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，免壽春營戶為揚州民。

translations.literal: Day yimao: garrison households of Shouchun were released and made people of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day garrison households of Shouchun were released and made people of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯，吐谷渾國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day dingmao: Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingmao day, Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛未，蕭寶卷零陵戍主華候率戶內屬。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Defending Commander of Lingling Garrison under Bao Juan, Hua Hou, led his households inward in submission.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Hua Hou, defending commander of Lingling garrison under Bao Juan, led his households inward in submission.

sentences.zh: 十有一月丙申，以驃騎大將軍穆亮為司空。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingshen: General of Agile Cavalry Mu Liang was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the bingshen day, Mu Liang, general of agile cavalry, was made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，大將軍、北海王詳為太傅，領司徒。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Grand General, Prince of Beihai Xiang was made Grand Tutor and held additionally the post of Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day Xiang, grand general and Prince of Beihai, was made grand tutor and held additionally the post of minister over the masses.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，改築圓丘於伊水之陽。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the Circular Mound Altar was rebuilt on the south bank of the Yi River.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day the Circular Mound Altar was rebuilt on the south bank of the Yi River.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，仍有事焉。

translations.literal: Day yimao: sacrifice was again performed there.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day sacrifice was again performed there.

sentences.zh: 十二月，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 是月，寶卷直後張齊殺其主寶卷降蕭衍，衍克建業。

translations.literal: That month Bao Juan's personal attendant Zhang Qi killed his lord Bao Juan and surrendered to Xiao Yan; Yan took Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: That month Bao Juan's personal attendant Zhang Qi killed his lord Bao Juan and surrendered to Xiao Yan; Yan took Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 三年春二月戊寅，詔曰：「自比陽旱積時，農民廢殖，寤言增愧，在予良多。

translations.literal: Third year, second month of spring, day wuyin: an edict said: "Since Biyang the drought has lasted long; farmers have abandoned cultivation; upon reflection shame increases—much rests on us.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the second month of spring, on the wuyin day, an edict said, "Since Biyang the drought has lasted long; farmers have abandoned cultivation; upon reflection shame increases—much rests on us.

sentences.zh: 申下州郡，有骸骨暴露者，悉可埋瘞。

translations.literal: Send down to provinces and commanderies: wherever bones lie exposed, all may be buried.
translations.idiomatic: Send down to provinces and commanderies: wherever bones lie exposed, all may be buried.

sentences.zh: 」三月，魯陽蠻反。

translations.literal: " Third month: the Luoyang barbarians rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: " In the third month the Luoyang barbarians rebelled.

sentences.zh: 蕭寶卷弟建安王寶夤來降。

translations.literal: Bao Juan's younger brother, Prince of Jian'an Bao Zhao, came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Juan's younger brother, Bao Zhao, Prince of Jian'an, came to surrender.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉，于闐國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day guiyou: Khotan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guiyou day, Khotan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 詔加文官從征顯達宿衞者二階，閑散者一階。

translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guichou day, Chai Qingzong, Jiaocheng garrison commander under Xiao Yan, brought the city to surrender.

sentences.zh: 李崇大破諸蠻帥樊素安。

translations.literal: Li Chong greatly defeated the barbarian chieftain Fan Su'an.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chong greatly defeated the barbarian chieftain Fan Su'an.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，元英破蕭衍將馬仙琕於義陽。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingzi: Yuan Ying defeated Xiao Yan's general Ma Xianbi at Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the bingzi day, Yuan Ying defeated Xiao Yan's general Ma Xianbi at Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 詔洛陽令有大事聽面敷奏。

translations.literal: An edict: the Prefect of Luoyang, on great affairs, may be heard in personal memorial at court.
translations.idiomatic: An edict allowed the prefect of Luoyang, on great affairs, to be heard in personal memorial at court.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，元英攻義陽，拔之，擒送蕭衍冠軍將軍蔡靈恩等十餘將。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Yuan Ying attacked Yiyang, took it, and sent captive Xiao Yan's General Who Champions Cai Ling'en and more than ten generals.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Yuan Ying attacked Yiyang, took it, and sent captive Cai Ling'en, Xiao Yan's general who champions, and more than ten generals.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，英又大破衍將，仍清三關。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Ying again greatly defeated Yan's generals and cleared the three passes.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day Ying again greatly defeated Yan's generals and cleared the three passes.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，封元英為中山王。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Yuan Ying was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day Yuan Ying was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，西羌宋萬率戶四千內附。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: the western Qiang Song Wan led four thousand households inward in submission.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day the western Qiang Song Wan led four thousand households inward in submission.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，詔緣淮南北所在鎮戍，皆令及秋播麥，春種粟稻，隨其土宜，水陸兼用，必使地無遺利，兵無餘力，比及來稔，令公私俱濟也。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingwu: an edict ordered garrisons north and south along the Huai, all to sow wheat by autumn and plant millet and rice in spring, according to local suitability using both land and water, so that the land yields without waste and troops without surplus strength—by the coming harvest both public and private may be aided alike.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the bingwu day, an edict ordered garrisons north and south along the Huai to sow wheat by autumn and plant millet and rice in spring according to local suitability, using both land and water, so that the land yields without waste and troops without surplus strength—by the coming harvest both public and private may be aided alike.

sentences.zh: 又詔諸州蠲停徭役，不得橫有徵發。

translations.literal: Another edict ordered all provinces to suspend corvée levies and not presumptuously impose extra collections.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict ordered all provinces to suspend corvée levies and not presumptuously impose extra collections.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔中山王英所執蕭衍冠軍將軍、監司州事蔡靈恩等隨才擢敍，乙丑，蕭衍霍州刺史田道龍、義州刺史張宗之遣使內附。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: an edict ordered that Cai Ling'en and others, Xiao Yan's general who champions and acting overseer of Si province, whom Prince of Zhongshan Ying had captured, be promoted according to talent; day yichou: Xiao Yan's Inspector of Huo province Tian Daolong and Inspector of Yi province Zhang Zongzhi sent envoys inward in submission.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day an edict ordered that Cai Ling'en and others, Xiao Yan's general who champions and acting overseer of Si province, whom Prince of Zhongshan Ying had captured, be promoted according to talent; on the yichou day Tian Daolong, Xiao Yan's inspector of Huo province, and Zhang Zongzhi, inspector of Yi province, sent envoys inward in submission.

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕犯塞，詔左僕射源懷討之。

translations.literal: The Rouran raided the frontier; an edict ordered Left Vice Director Yuan Huai to punish them.
translations.idiomatic: The Rouran raided the frontier; an edict ordered Yuan Huai, left vice director, to punish them.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未，詔斷羣官白衣募吏。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day yiwei: an edict forbade officials in plain dress from recruiting clerks.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the yiwei day, an edict forbade officials in plain dress from recruiting clerks.

sentences.zh: 十有一月戊午，詔曰：「古之哲王，創業垂統，安民立化，莫不崇建膠序，開訓國冑，昭宣三禮，崇明四術，使道暢羣邦，風流萬宇。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuwu: an edict said: "The sage kings of old, founding enterprise and handing down succession, settling the people and establishing transformation, all honored the glue-and-lin academies, opened instruction for the imperial scions, made bright the three rites, and exalted the four arts, so that the Way pervaded the myriad states and influence flowed to the ten thousand realms.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the wuwu day, an edict said, "The sage kings of old, founding enterprise and handing down succession, settling the people and establishing transformation, all honored the glue-and-lin academies, opened instruction for the imperial scions, made bright the three rites, and exalted the four arts, so that the Way pervaded the myriad states and influence flowed to the ten thousand realms.

sentences.zh: 自皇基徙構，光宅中區，軍國務殷，未遑經建，靖言思之，有慚古烈。

translations.literal: Since the imperial foundation moved and was re-established in the central region, military and state affairs have been pressing and the classics could not yet be built—reflecting on this, we are ashamed before the ancient exemplars.
translations.idiomatic: Since the imperial foundation moved and was re-established in the central region, military and state affairs have been pressing and the classics could not yet be built—reflecting on this, we are ashamed before the ancient exemplars.

sentences.zh: 可敕有司依漢魏舊章，營繕國學。

translations.literal: Let the relevant offices, following Han and Wei old statutes, repair and build the National University.
translations.idiomatic: Let the relevant offices, following Han and Wei old statutes, repair and build the National University.

sentences.zh: 」十有二月丙子，以苑牧公田分賜代遷之戶。

translations.literal: " Twelfth month, day bingzi: park and pasture public fields were divided and given to households of the relocated capital.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twelfth month, on the bingzi day, park and pasture public fields were divided and given to households of the relocated capital.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔羣臣議定律令。

translations.literal: Day jimao: an edict ordered the assembled ministers to deliberate on fixing laws and ordinances.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day an edict ordered the assembled ministers to deliberate on fixing laws and ordinances.

sentences.zh: 己亥，行幸伊闕。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the court traveled to Yique.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day the court traveled to Yique.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸卯朔，蕭衍行梁州事夏侯道遷據漢中來降，假尚書邢巒鎮西將軍，率眾以赴之。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day guimao, new moon: Xiahou Daqian, Xiao Yan's acting inspector of Liangzhou, held Hanzhong and came to surrender; Acting Master of Writing Xing Luan was made acting General Who Pacifies the West and led troops to go to him.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the intercalary month, the new moon, Xiahou Daqian, Xiao Yan's acting inspector of Liangzhou, held Hanzhong and came to surrender; Xing Luan, acting master of writing, was made acting general who pacifies the west and led troops to go to him.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，驃騎大將軍、高陽王雍為司空，尚書令、廣陽王嘉加儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day yichou: General of Agile Cavalry, Prince of Gaoyang Yong was made Minister of Works; Master of Writing, Prince of Guangyang Jia was given equipage equal to the Three Directors.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Yong, general of agile cavalry and Prince of Gaoyang, was made minister of works; Jia, master of writing and Prince of Guangyang, was given equipage equal to the Three Directors.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丙子，以宕昌國世子梁彌博為其國王。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, day bingzi: the heir of Dangchang, Liang Mibo, was made king of his state.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the first month of spring, on the bingzi day, Liang Mibo, heir of Dangchang, was made king of his state.

sentences.zh: 鄧至國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: The state of Dengzhi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Dengzhi sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月，梁州氐反，絕漢中運路。

translations.literal: Second month: the Di of Liangzhou rebelled and cut the Hanzhong supply route.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the Di of Liangzhou rebelled and cut the Hanzhong supply route.

sentences.zh: 刺史邢巒頻大破之。

translations.literal: Inspector Xing Luan repeatedly greatly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector Xing Luan repeatedly greatly defeated them.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己未，城陽王鸞薨。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day jiwei: Prince of Chengyang Luan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiwei day, Luan, Prince of Chengyang, died.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔曰：「任賢明治，自昔通規，宣風贊務，實惟多士。

translations.literal: Day yichou: an edict said: "Appointing the worthy to illumine government is a constant rule since old; proclaiming influence and aiding affairs truly depends on many officers.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day an edict said, "Appointing the worthy to illumine government is a constant rule since old; proclaiming influence and aiding affairs truly depends on many officers.

sentences.zh: 而中正所銓，但存門第，吏部彝倫，仍不才舉。

translations.literal: Yet what the Rectifiers select preserves only family status; the Masters of Writing in their ordering still do not raise men for talent.
translations.idiomatic: Yet what the Rectifiers select preserves only family status; the Masters of Writing in their ordering still do not raise men for talent.

sentences.zh: 遂使英德罕昇，司務多滯。

translations.literal: Thus outstanding virtue rarely rises and office affairs are much delayed.
translations.idiomatic: Thus outstanding virtue rarely rises and office affairs are much delayed.

sentences.zh: 不精厥選，將何考陟？

translations.literal: If the selection is not refined, how shall promotion be examined?
translations.idiomatic: If the selection is not refined, how shall promotion be examined?

sentences.zh: 八座可審議往代貢士之方，擢賢之體，必令才學並申，資望兼致。

translations.literal: The Eight Seats shall deliberate the methods of former ages for presenting scholars and the forms for elevating the worthy, so that talent and learning are both displayed and qualification and standing both attained.
translations.idiomatic: The Eight Seats shall deliberate the methods of former ages for presenting scholars and the forms for elevating the worthy, so that talent and learning are both displayed and qualification and standing both attained.

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，以仇池氐叛，詔光祿大夫楊椿假平西將軍，率眾以討之。

translations.literal: " Day bingyin: because the Di of Chouchi rebelled, an edict ordered Grand Master of Splendor Yang Chun, acting General Who Pacifies the West, to lead troops to punish them.
translations.idiomatic: " On the bingyin day, because the Di of Chouchi rebelled, an edict ordered Yang Chun, grand master of splendor and acting general who pacifies the west, to lead troops to punish them.

sentences.zh: 邢巒遣統軍王足西伐，頻破蕭衍諸軍，遂入劍閣，執衍輔國將軍范始男送京師。

translations.literal: Xing Luan sent Commander Wang Zu on a western campaign and repeatedly defeated Xiao Yan's armies, entered Jianmen Pass, and sent captive Xiao Yan's General Who Assists the State Fan Shinan to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Luan sent Commander Wang Zu on a western campaign and repeatedly defeated Xiao Yan's armies, entered Jianmen Pass, and sent captive Fan Shinan, Xiao Yan's general who assists the state, to the capital.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，氐賊□虎率眾降。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinsi: the Di bandit □ Hu led his hosts to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the xinsi day, the Di bandit Hu led his hosts to surrender.

sentences.zh: 六月己丑，詔曰：「先朝勳臣，或身罹譴黜，子孫沉滯；

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jichou: an edict said: "Meritorious ministers of the former court—some personally suffered punishment and demotion, and their descendants sank into obscurity;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jichou day, an edict said, "Meritorious ministers of the former court—some personally suffered punishment and demotion, and their descendants sank into obscurity;

sentences.zh: 或宦途失次，有替舊流，因而弗採，何以奬勸？

translations.literal: some lost proper sequence on the official path and fell from the old stream—because of this they were not selected; how shall encouragement be offered?
translations.idiomatic: some lost proper sequence on the official path and fell from the old stream—because of this they were not selected; how shall encouragement be offered?

sentences.zh: 言念前績，情有親疏。

translations.literal: Speaking of former achievement, feeling has its near and far.
translations.idiomatic: Speaking of former achievement, feeling has its near and far.

sentences.zh: 宗及庶族，祖曾功績可紀，而無朝官，有官而才堪優引者，隨才銓授。」

translations.literal: Among the clan and common kindred, where the achievements of grandfather, great-grandfather, and father can be recorded yet there is no court office—or there is office and talent suffices for exceptional promotion—let appointment follow talent."
translations.idiomatic: Among the clan and common kindred, where the achievements of grandfather, great-grandfather, and father can be recorded yet there is no court office—or there is office and talent suffices for exceptional promotion—let appointment follow talent."

sentences.zh: 甲寅，蕭衍冠軍將軍李畋等置營始平郡東，[9]涪水之北。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Xiao Yan's general who champions Li Tian and others set camp east of Shiping commandery, [9] north of the Fu River.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Li Tian, Xiao Yan's general who champions, and others set camp east of Shiping commandery, [9] north of the Fu River.

sentences.zh: 王足逆擊敗之，斬衍冠軍將軍張湯，輔國將軍馬市，寧朔將軍李當、姜見祖，輔國將軍馮文豪，龍驤將軍何營之等。

translations.literal: Wang Zu met and defeated them, beheading Xiao Yan's general who champions Zhang Tang, general who assists the state Ma Shi, general who calms the north Li Dang and Jiang Jianzu, general who assists the state Feng Wenhao, general of the dragon cavalry He Yingzhi, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zu met and defeated them, beheading Zhang Tang, Xiao Yan's general who champions, Ma Shi, general who assists the state, Li Dang and Jiang Jianzu, generals who calm the north, Feng Wenhao, general who assists the state, He Yingzhi, general of the dragon cavalry, and others.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔尚書李崇、太府卿于忠、散騎常侍游肇、諫議大夫鄧羨，崇、忠使持節並兼侍中，羨兼黃門，俱為大使，糾斷外州畿內，其守令之徒咎失彰露者，即便施決，州鎮重職，聽為表聞。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: an edict ordered Master of Writing Li Chong, Minister of the Imperial Treasury Yu Zhong, Regular Attendant You Zhao, and Remonstrator and Critic Deng Xian—Chong and Zhong with staffs of authority and additionally palace attendants, Xian additionally Yellow Gate—all as great envoys to investigate and decide within the outer provinces and inside the capital districts; where prefects, magistrates, and the like had exposed faults and losses, they were at once to execute judgment; for weighty posts in provinces and garrisons, memorials were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day an edict ordered Li Chong, master of writing, Yu Zhong, minister of the imperial treasury, You Zhao, regular attendant, and Deng Xian, remonstrator and critic—Chong and Zhong with staffs of authority and additionally palace attendants, Xian additionally yellow gate—all as great envoys to investigate and decide within the outer provinces and inside the capital districts; where prefects, magistrates, and the like had exposed faults and losses, they were at once to execute judgment; for weighty posts in provinces and garrisons, memorials were permitted.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，蕭衍冠軍將軍王景胤、輔國將軍魯方達等攻竹亭，王足大破之，斬其輔國將軍王明達、龍驤將軍張方熾。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Xiao Yan's general who champions Wang Jingyin and general who assists the state Lu Fangda and others attacked Zhuting; Wang Zu greatly defeated them and beheaded his general who assists the state Wang Mingda and general of the dragon cavalry Zhang Fangchi.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Wang Jingyin, Xiao Yan's general who champions, Lu Fangda, general who assists the state, and others attacked Zhuting; Wang Zu greatly defeated them and beheaded Wang Mingda, general who assists the state, and Zhang Fangchi, general of the dragon cavalry.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，揚州刺史薛真度大破蕭衍將王超宗，俘斬三千級。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Military Inspector of Yangzhou Xue Zhendu greatly defeated Xiao Yan's general Wang Chaozong and captured and beheaded three thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day Xue Zhendu, military inspector of Yangzhou, greatly defeated Xiao Yan's general Wang Chaozong and captured and beheaded three thousand.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，蕭衍將魯方達屯戍新城，足又遣統軍盧祖遷等擊敗之，斬衍冠軍將軍楊伯仁、寧朔將軍任安定。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Xiao Yan's general Lu Fangda garrisoned and defended Xincheng; Zu again sent Commander Lu Zuqian and others to defeat them and beheaded Xiao Yan's general who champions Yang Boren and general who calms the north Ren Anding.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day Lu Fangda, Xiao Yan's general, garrisoned and defended Xincheng; Zu again sent Lu Zuqian, commander, and others to defeat them and beheaded Yang Boren, Xiao Yan's general who champions, and Ren Anding, general who calms the north.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌，詔曰：「朕纂馭寶曆，於今七載，德澤未敷，鑒不燭遠，人之冤瘼，所在猶滋，而糾察之獄未暢于下，賢愚靡分，皂白均貫，非所以革民耳目，使善惡勵心。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day jiaxu: an edict said: "We have inherited and steered the imperial succession; for seven years now virtue has not spread abroad and the mirror does not illumine far—people's wrongs and suffering still flourish wherever one looks, yet the prisons of investigation do not flow freely below, worthy and foolish are not distinguished, black and white run together—this is not how to renew the people's eyes and ears and make good and evil stir the heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiaxu day, an edict said, "We have inherited and steered the imperial succession; for seven years now virtue has not spread abroad and the mirror does not illumine far—people's wrongs and suffering still flourish wherever one looks, yet the prisons of investigation do not flow freely below, worthy and foolish are not distinguished, black and white run together—this is not how to renew the people's eyes and ears and make good and evil stir the heart.

sentences.zh: 今分遣大使，省方巡檢，隨其愆負與風響相符者，即加糾黜，以明雷霆之威，以申旄軒之舉，因以觀風辨俗，採訪功過，褒賞賢者，糾罰淫慝，理窮恤弊，以稱朕心。」

translations.literal: Now great envoys are dispatched separately to inspect provinces, touring and examining; wherever fault and burden match local reputation, add investigation and dismissal at once, to display the thunder's majesty and extend the bannered carriage's action—thereby observing customs and distinguishing practices, gathering reports of merit and fault, rewarding the worthy, punishing the licentious and wicked, exhausting reason and relieving distress, to answer our heart."
translations.idiomatic: Now great envoys are dispatched separately to inspect provinces, touring and examining; wherever fault and burden match local reputation, add investigation and dismissal at once, to display the thunder's majesty and extend the bannered carriage's action—thereby observing customs and distinguishing practices, gathering reports of merit and fault, rewarding the worthy, punishing the licentious and wicked, exhausting reason and relieving distress, to answer our heart."

sentences.zh: 戊子，王足擊破蕭衍軍，斬其龍驤將軍喻增暉、寧朔將軍庫保壽、輔國將軍魯天惠、建武將軍王文標。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Wang Zu defeated Xiao Yan's army and beheaded his general of the dragon cavalry Yu Zenghui, general who calms the north Ku Baoshou, general who assists the state Lu Tianhui, and general who establishes martial prowess Wang Wenbiao.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Wang Zu defeated Xiao Yan's army and beheaded Yu Zenghui, general of the dragon cavalry, Ku Baoshou, general who calms the north, Lu Tianhui, general who assists the state, and Wang Wenbiao, general who establishes martial prowess.

sentences.zh: 王足逼涪城，壬辰，蕭衍巴西太守庾域，冠軍將軍、統軍主李畋等逆戰，足擊破之，俘斬千數。

translations.literal: Wang Zu pressed Fucheng; day renchen: Xiao Yan's Administrator of Baxi, Yu Yu, general who champions and army commander Li Tian and others met in battle; Zu defeated them and captured and beheaded thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zu pressed Fucheng; on the renchen day Yu Yu, Xiao Yan's administrator of Baxi, Li Tian, general who champions and army commander, and others met in battle; Zu defeated them and captured and beheaded thousands.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，詔中山王英南討襄、沔。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renyin: an edict ordered Prince of Zhongshan Ying on a southern campaign against Xiang and Mian.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the renyin day, an edict ordered Ying, Prince of Zhongshan, on a southern campaign against Xiang and Mian.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，王足遣統軍紀洪雅、盧祖遷等攻破衍軍，斬其秦梁二州刺史魯方達等十五人。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Wang Zu sent Commanders Ji Hongya and Lu Zuqian and others to defeat Yan's army and beheaded his Inspectors of Qin and Liang provinces Lu Fangda and fourteen others.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Wang Zu sent Ji Hongya and Lu Zuqian, commanders, and others to defeat Yan's army and beheaded Lu Fangda, Xiao Yan's inspectors of Qin and Liang provinces, and fourteen others.

sentences.zh: 壬子，王足又遣統軍盧祖遷等擊破衍軍，斬其都督、冠軍將軍、梓潼縣開國子王景胤，劉達等二十四將軍。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Wang Zu again sent Commander Lu Zuqian and others to defeat Yan's army and beheaded his Area Commander, general who champions, Marquis of Zitong county, state founding, Wang Jingyin, Liu Da, and twenty-four generals.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day Wang Zu again sent Lu Zuqian, commander, and others to defeat Yan's army and beheaded Wang Jingyin, area commander, general who champions, and Marquis of Zitong county, state founding, Liu Da, and twenty-four generals.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，揚州擊衍將姜慶真於羊石，破之。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Yangzhou attacked Xiao Yan's general Jiang Qingzhen at Yangshi and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Yangzhou attacked Jiang Qingzhen, Xiao Yan's general, at Yangshi and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 是月，衍沔東太守田青喜率郡七、縣三十一、戶萬九十內附。

translations.literal: That month Tian Qingxi, Administrator of Yan's east of the Mian, led seven commanderies, thirty-one counties, and ten thousand ninety households inward in submission.
translations.idiomatic: That month Tian Qingxi, Xiao Yan's administrator east of the Mian, led seven commanderies, thirty-one counties, and ten thousand ninety households inward in submission.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，揚州刺史元嵩擊破衍湘州刺史楊公則等，斬獲數千。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jisi: Yuan Song, military inspector of Yangzhou, defeated Xiao Yan's Inspector of Xiangzhou Yang Gongze and others and captured and beheaded several thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jisi day, Yuan Song, military inspector of Yangzhou, defeated Yang Gongze, Xiao Yan's inspector of Xiangzhou, and others and captured and beheaded several thousand.

sentences.zh: 冬十有一月戊辰朔，武興國王楊紹先叔父集起謀反，詔光祿大夫楊椿討之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month of winter, day wuchen, new moon: the king of Wuxing, Yang Shaoxian's uncle Jiqing plotted rebellion; an edict ordered Grand Master of Splendor Yang Chun to punish him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the wuchen day, the new moon, Jiqing, uncle of Yang Shaoxian, king of Wuxing, plotted rebellion; an edict ordered Yang Chun, grand master of splendor, to punish him.

sentences.zh: 王足圍涪城，益州諸郡戍降者十二三，民送編籍者五萬餘戶。

translations.literal: Wang Zu besieged Fucheng; of garrisons in the Yi provinces twelve or thirteen surrendered, and the people sent household registers—more than fifty thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zu besieged Fucheng; of garrisons in the Yi provinces twelve or thirteen surrendered, and the people sent household registers—more than fifty thousand households.

sentences.zh: 既而足引軍而退。

translations.literal: Soon after Zu withdrew his army.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after Zu withdrew his army.

sentences.zh: 十有二月庚申，又詔驃騎大將軍源懷慎，[10]令討武興反氐。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengshen: again an edict ordered General of Agile Cavalry Yuan Huai to be cautious, [10] and sent him to punish the rebel Di of Wuxing.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengshen day, again an edict ordered Yuan Huai, general of agile cavalry, to be cautious [10] and sent him to punish the rebel Di of Wuxing.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丁卯朔，皇子生，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, day dingmao, new moon: an imperial son was born; general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the first month of spring, on the dingmao day, the new moon, an imperial son was born and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 壬申，梁秦二州刺史邢巒連破氐賊，克武興。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Xing Luan, military inspector of Liang and Qin provinces, repeatedly defeated the Di bandits and took Wuxing.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day Xing Luan, military inspector of Liang and Qin provinces, repeatedly defeated the Di bandits and took Wuxing.

sentences.zh: 蕭衍冀州刺史桓和入寇南青州，州軍擊走之。

translations.literal: Xiao Yan's Inspector of Ji province Huan He entered to raid South Qing province; the provincial army drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yan's inspector of Ji province Huan He entered to raid South Qing province; the provincial army drove him off.

sentences.zh: 秦州民王灋智等聚眾二千自號王公，尋推秦州主簿呂苟兒為主，年號建明。

translations.literal: The people of Qinzhou, Wang Fazhi and others, gathered a crowd of two thousand and styled themselves kings; soon they made Qinzhou registrar Lü Gou'er lord, era name Jianming.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Qinzhou, Wang Fazhi and others, gathered a crowd of two thousand and styled themselves kings; soon they made Lü Gou'er, Qinzhou registrar, lord, with era name Jianming.

sentences.zh: 己卯，楊集起兄弟相率降。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Yang Jiqing and his brothers led one another in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day Yang Jiqing and his brothers led one another in surrender.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰，詔曰：「昔虞戒面從，昌言屢進；

translations.literal: Second month, day bingchen: an edict said: "Of old Yu warned against fair words to the face while secret words are repeatedly offered;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the bingchen day, an edict said, "Of old Yu warned against fair words to the face while secret words are repeatedly offered;

sentences.zh: 周任諫輔，王闕必箴。

translations.literal: the Zhou officer charged with remonstrance was to admonish—where the king had gaps, he must needle them.
translations.idiomatic: the Zhou officer charged with remonstrance was to admonish—where the king had gaps, he must needle them.

sentences.zh: 朕仰纘鴻基，伏膺寶曆，思康庶績，一日萬幾，是以側望忠言，虛求讜直。

translations.literal: We look up to continue the great foundation and bow to receive the imperial succession, thinking to bring peace to the myriad tasks, ten thousand affairs in a day—therefore we turn aside to await loyal words and emptyly seek straight counsel.
translations.idiomatic: We look up to continue the great foundation and bow to receive the imperial succession, thinking to bring peace to the myriad tasks, ten thousand affairs in a day—therefore we turn aside to await loyal words and emptyly seek straight counsel.

sentences.zh: 而良策弗進，規畫無聞，豈所謂弼諧元首，匡救不逮者乎？

translations.literal: Yet good plans do not advance and schemes are unheard—can this be called harmonizing the chief, remedying what does not reach?"
translations.idiomatic: Yet good plans do not advance and schemes are unheard—can this be called harmonizing the chief, remedying what does not reach?"

sentences.zh: 可詔王公已下，其有嘉謀深圖、直言忠諫、利國便民、矯時厲俗者，咸令指事陳奏，無或依違。

translations.literal: Let dukes and princes and below be edicted: whoever has excellent plans and deep designs, frank words and loyal remonstrance, benefit to the state and convenience to the people, or correction of the age and sternness to custom—all are to point to the matter and memorialize; none may hedge.
translations.idiomatic: Let dukes and princes and below be edicted: whoever has excellent plans and deep designs, frank words and loyal remonstrance, benefit to the state and convenience to the people, or correction of the age and sternness to custom—all are to point to the matter and memorialize; none may hedge.

sentences.zh: 」戊午，詔右衞將軍元麗等討呂苟兒。

translations.literal: " Day wuwu: an edict ordered Right Guards General Yuan Li and others to punish Lü Gou'er.
translations.idiomatic: " On the wuwu day an edict ordered Yuan Li, right guards general, and others to punish Lü Gou'er.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，平南將軍陳伯之破蕭衍徐州刺史昌義之於梁城。

translations.literal: Day yichou: General Who Pacifies the South Chen Bozhi defeated Xiao Yan's Inspector of Xuzhou Chang Yizhi at Liangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Chen Bozhi, general who pacifies the south, defeated Chang Yizhi, Xiao Yan's inspector of Xuzhou, at Liangcheng.

sentences.zh: 是月，衍將蕭昞率眾五萬寇淮陽。

translations.literal: That month Xiao Yan's general Xiao Min led fifty thousand men to raid Huaiyang.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xiao Min, Xiao Yan's general, led fifty thousand men to raid Huaiyang.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，以戎旅大興，詔罷諸作。

translations.literal: Third month, day jisi: because the army was greatly raised, an edict halted all construction.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jisi day, because the army was greatly raised, an edict halted all construction.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔荊州刺史趙怡、平南將軍奚康生赴淮陽。

translations.literal: Day jimao: an edict ordered Inspector of Jing province Zhao Yi and General Who Pacifies the South Xi Kangsheng to go to Huaiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day an edict ordered Zhao Yi, inspector of Jing province, and Xi Kangsheng, general who pacifies the south, to go to Huaiyang.

sentences.zh: 樂良王長命坐殺人賜死，國除。

translations.literal: Prince of Lelang Zhangming was sentenced to death for killing a man; the state was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangming, Prince of Lelang, was sentenced to death for killing a man; the state was abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊子，名皇子曰昌。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: the imperial son was named Chang.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day the imperial son was named Chang.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，平南將軍、曲江縣開國公陳伯之自梁城南奔。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: General Who Pacifies the South, Marquis of Qujiang county, state founding, Chen Bozhi fled south from Liangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day Chen Bozhi, general who pacifies the south and Marquis of Qujiang county, state founding, fled south from Liangcheng.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，[11]詔罷鹽池禁。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day yiwei: [11] an edict abolished the salt-pond prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the yiwei day, [11] an edict abolished the salt-pond prohibition.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔遣使者巡慰北邊酋庶。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: an edict dispatched envoys to tour and comfort chieftains and commoners of the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day an edict dispatched envoys to tour and comfort chieftains and commoners of the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以中山王英為征南將軍、都督揚徐二道諸軍事，指授邊將。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Prince of Zhongshan Ying was made General Who Campaigns South and Area Commander of all military affairs on the Yang and Xu circuits, instructing frontier generals.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Ying, Prince of Zhongshan, was made general who campaigns south and area commander of all military affairs on the Yang and Xu circuits, instructing frontier generals.

sentences.zh: 蕭衍江州刺史王茂先寇荊州，屯於河南城，詔平南將軍楊大眼討之。

translations.literal: Xiao Yan's Inspector of Jiangzhou Wang Mao first raided Jing province and encamped at Henancheng; an edict ordered General Who Pacifies the South Yang Dayan to punish him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mao, Xiao Yan's inspector of Jiangzhou, first raided Jing province and encamped at Henancheng; an edict ordered Yang Dayan, general who pacifies the south, to punish him.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大破之，斬其輔國將軍王花，首虜二千餘。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: he greatly defeated them and beheaded his general who assists the state Wang Hua; heads and captives exceeded two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day he greatly defeated them and beheaded Wang Hua, general who assists the state; heads and captives exceeded two thousand.

sentences.zh: 進攻河南城，茂先逃潰，追奔至於漢水，拔其五城。

translations.literal: He advanced to attack Henancheng; Mao first fled in rout; pursuit ran to the Han River and took his five cities.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced to attack Henancheng; Mao first fled in rout; pursuit ran to the Han River and took his five cities.

sentences.zh: 將軍宇文福略衍司州，俘獲千餘口而還。

translations.literal: General Yuwen Fu raided Xiao Yan's Si province, captured more than a thousand mouths, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: General Yuwen Fu raided Xiao Yan's Si province, captured more than a thousand mouths, and returned.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑朔，詔尚書拯義陽初附之戶。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yichou, new moon: an edict ordered the Masters of Writing to relieve the households newly attached at Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the yichou day, the new moon, an edict ordered the Masters of Writing to relieve the households newly attached at Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔曰：「掩骼埋胔，古之令典，順辰修令，朝之恒式。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: an edict said: "Covering bones and burying flesh is an ancient statute; following the season to repair ordinances is the court's constant form.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day an edict said, "Covering bones and burying flesh is an ancient statute; following the season to repair ordinances is the court's constant form.

sentences.zh: 今時澤未降，春稼已旱。

translations.literal: Now seasonal rain has not yet fallen and spring crops are already drought-stricken.
translations.idiomatic: Now seasonal rain has not yet fallen and spring crops are already drought-stricken.

sentences.zh: 或有孤老餒疾，無人贍救，因以致死，暴露溝塹者，洛陽部尉依法棺埋。

translations.literal: Some solitary elderly starve or fall ill with no one to support them and thus die, exposed in ditches and moats—the Luoyang commandery captain shall bury them in coffins according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Some solitary elderly starve or fall ill with no one to support them and thus die, exposed in ditches and moats—the Luoyang commandery captain shall bury them in coffins according to law.

sentences.zh: 」壬申，蕭衍將張惠紹入寇，陷宿豫。

translations.literal: " Day renshen: Xiao Yan's general Zhang Huishao entered to raid and took Suyu.
translations.idiomatic: " On the renshen day Zhang Huishao, Xiao Yan's general, entered to raid and took Suyu.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，衍將蕭容陷梁城。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Xiao Yan's general Xiao Rong took Liangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day Xiao Rong, Xiao Yan's general, took Liangcheng.

sentences.zh: [12]辛巳，衍將韋叡陷合肥城。

translations.literal: [12] Day xinsi: Xiao Yan's general Wei Rui took Hefei fortress.
translations.idiomatic: [12] On the xinsi day Wei Rui, Xiao Yan's general, took Hefei fortress.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔尚書元遙率眾南討。

translations.literal: Day renwu: an edict ordered Master of Writing Yuan Yao to lead troops south to punish.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day an edict ordered Yuan Yao, master of writing, to lead troops south to punish.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以秦隴未平，詔征西將軍于勁節度諸軍。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: because Qin and Long were not yet pacified, an edict ordered General Who Campaigns West Yu Jin to coordinate all armies.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, because Qin and Long were not yet pacified, an edict ordered Yu Jin, general who campaigns west, to coordinate all armies.

sentences.zh: 己丑，衍將又陷羊石、霍丘二城。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Xiao Yan's generals again took Yangshi and Huoqiu fortresses.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day Xiao Yan's generals again took Yangshi and Huoqiu fortresses.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑，又陷小峴戍。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinchou: they again took Xiaoxian garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the xinchou day, they again took Xiaoxian garrison.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，安西將軍元麗大破秦賊，斬賊帥王灋智五人，梟首六千。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Acting General Who Pacifies the West Yuan Li greatly defeated the Qin bandits, beheaded five bandit chiefs including Wang Fazhi, and exposed six thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day Yuan Li, acting general who pacifies the west, greatly defeated the Qin bandits, beheaded five bandit chiefs including Wang Fazhi, and exposed six thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 丁未，假平南將軍奚康生破蕭衍將張惠紹，斬其徐州刺史宋黑。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Acting General Who Pacifies the South Xi Kangsheng defeated Xiao Yan's general Zhang Huishao and beheaded his Inspector of Xuzhou Song Hei.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day Xi Kangsheng, acting general who pacifies the south, defeated Zhang Huishao, Xiao Yan's general, and beheaded Song Hei, inspector of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔尚書邢巒出討徐兗。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: an edict ordered Master of Writing Xing Luan to go out and punish Xu and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day an edict ordered Xing Luan, master of writing, to go out and punish Xu and Yan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙寅，衍將桓和寇孤山，陷固城。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day bingyin: Xiao Yan's general Huan He raided Gushan and took Gucheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the bingyin day, Huan He, Xiao Yan's general, raided Gushan and took Gucheng.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，元麗大破秦賊，降呂苟兒及其王公三十餘人，秦涇二州平。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Yuan Li greatly defeated the Qin bandits, and Lü Gou'er and his kings and dukes, more than thirty men, surrendered; Qin and Jing provinces were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day Yuan Li greatly defeated the Qin bandits, and Lü Gou'er and his kings and dukes, more than thirty men, surrendered; Qin and Jing provinces were pacified.

sentences.zh: 戊子，中山王英大破衍徐州刺史王伯敖於陰陵，斬其將二十五人，首虜五千有餘。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Prince of Zhongshan Ying greatly defeated Xiao Yan's Inspector of Xuzhou Wang Bo'ao at Yinling, beheaded twenty-five of his generals, and took heads and captives exceeding five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Ying, Prince of Zhongshan, greatly defeated Wang Bo'ao, Xiao Yan's inspector of Xuzhou, at Yinling, beheaded twenty-five of his generals, and took heads and captives exceeding five thousand.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔發定、冀、瀛、相、并、肆六州十萬人以濟南軍。

translations.literal: Day jichou: an edict levied one hundred thousand men from Ding, Ji, Ying, Xiang, Bing, and Si provinces to reinforce the southern army.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day an edict levied one hundred thousand men from Ding, Ji, Ying, Xiang, Bing, and Si provinces to reinforce the southern army.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，安東將軍邢巒破蕭衍將桓和於孤山，斬首萬餘級。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renyin: General Who Pacifies the East Xing Luan defeated Xiao Yan's general Huan He at Gushan and took heads exceeding ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the renyin day, Xing Luan, general who pacifies the east, defeated Huan He, Xiao Yan's general, at Gushan and took heads exceeding ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 將軍元恒別克固城，斬衍冠軍將軍桓方慶。

translations.literal: General Yuan Heng separately took Gucheng and beheaded Xiao Yan's general who champions Huan Fangqing.
translations.idiomatic: General Yuan Heng separately took Gucheng and beheaded Huan Fangqing, Xiao Yan's general who champions.

sentences.zh: 統軍畢祖朽別克蒙山，斬衍龍驤將軍矯道儀等，斬賊及赴沂死者四千餘人。

translations.literal: Commander Bi Zuxiu separately took Mengshan and beheaded Xiao Yan's general of the dragon cavalry Jiao Daoyi and others; bandits and those who drowned fleeing to the Yi exceeded four thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Bi Zuxiu separately took Mengshan and beheaded Jiao Daoyi, Xiao Yan's general of the dragon cavalry, and others; bandits and those who drowned fleeing to the Yi exceeded four thousand.

sentences.zh: 兗州平。

translations.literal: Yan province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Yan province was pacified.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔平南將軍、安樂王詮督後發諸軍以赴淮南。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: an edict ordered General Who Pacifies the South, Prince of Anle Quan, to supervise the later-arriving armies going to Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day an edict ordered Quan, general who pacifies the south and Prince of Anle, to supervise the later-arriving armies going to Huainan.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，曲赦涇、秦、岐、涼、河五州。

translations.literal: Day renxu: partial amnesty in Jing, Qin, Qi, Liang, and He provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day a partial amnesty was proclaimed in Jing, Qin, Qi, Liang, and He provinces.

sentences.zh: 九月癸酉，邢巒大破衍軍於宿豫，斬其大將藍懷恭等四十餘人。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guiyou: Xing Luan greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army at Suyu and beheaded his great generals Lan Huigong and more than forty others.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guiyou day, Xing Luan greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army at Suyu and beheaded his great generals Lan Huigong and more than forty others.

sentences.zh: 張惠紹棄宿豫，蕭昞棄淮陽南走，追斬數萬級。

translations.literal: Zhang Huishao abandoned Suyu; Xiao Min abandoned Huaiyang and fled south; pursuit beheaded tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Huishao abandoned Suyu; Xiao Min abandoned Huaiyang and fled south; pursuit beheaded tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 徐州平。

translations.literal: Xuzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Xuzhou was pacified.

sentences.zh: 己丑，中山王英大破衍軍於淮南，衍中軍大將軍、臨川王蕭宏，尚書右僕射柳惔，徐州刺史昌義之等棄梁城沿淮東走。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Prince of Zhongshan Ying greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army at Huainan; Xiao Hong, Xiao Yan's general of the central army and Prince of Linchuan, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Liu Yan, and Inspector of Xuzhou Chang Yizhi abandoned Liangcheng and fled east along the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day Ying, Prince of Zhongshan, greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army at Huainan; Xiao Hong, Xiao Yan's general of the central army and Prince of Linchuan, Liu Yan, right vice director of the Masters of Writing, and Chang Yizhi, inspector of Xuzhou, abandoned Liangcheng and fled east along the Huai.

sentences.zh: 追奔次於馬頭，衍冠軍將軍、戍主朱思遠棄城宵遁，擒送衍將四十餘人，斬獲士卒五萬有餘。

translations.literal: Pursuit halted at Matou; Xiao Yan's general who champions and garrison commander Zhu Siyuan abandoned the city and fled by night; more than forty of Yan's generals were captured and sent; soldiers beheaded and captured exceeded fifty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuit halted at Matou; Zhu Siyuan, Xiao Yan's general who champions and garrison commander, abandoned the city and fled by night; more than forty of Yan's generals were captured and sent; soldiers beheaded and captured exceeded fifty thousand.

sentences.zh: 英遂攻鍾離。

translations.literal: Ying then attacked Zhongli.
translations.idiomatic: Ying then attacked Zhongli.

sentences.zh: 高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 蕭衍遣將士卒三萬寇義陽。

translations.literal: Xiao Yan dispatched generals and soldiers, thirty thousand, to raid Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yan dispatched generals and soldiers, thirty thousand, to raid Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，夜遁走，郢州刺史婁悅追擊，破之。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: at night they fled; Inspector of Yingzhou Lou Yue pursued and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, at night, they fled; Lou Yue, inspector of Yingzhou, pursued and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 戊申，蠕蠕國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Day wushen: the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己未，征虜將軍趙遐大破衍眾於灙城桑坪。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: General Who Campaigns the Barbarians Zhao Xia greatly defeated Xiao Yan's hosts at Sangping of Tangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day Zhao Xia, general who campaigns the barbarians, greatly defeated Xiao Yan's hosts at Sangping of Tangcheng.

sentences.zh: 十有一月甲子，帝為京兆王愉、清河王懌、廣平王懷、汝南王悅講孝經於式乾殿。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiazi: the emperor lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety to Princes of Jingzhao Yu, Qinghe Yi, Guangping Huai, and Runan Yue at the Shigan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jiazi day, the emperor lectured on the Classic of Filial Piety to Yu, Prince of Jingzhao, Yi, Prince of Qinghe, Huai, Prince of Guangping, and Yue, Prince of Runan, at the Shigan Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔曰：「往歲隴右扇逆，合境不民。
