translations.literal: On xinchou day, an edict pardoned the people of Jizhou among corvée laborers who had been misled by Yuan Yu; those who could behead and capture rebels were to receive special rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, an edict pardoned the people of Jizhou among corvée laborers who had been misled by Yuan Yu; those who could behead and capture rebels were to receive special rewards.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，李平克信都，元愉北走，斬其所署冀州牧韋超、右衞將軍睦雅、[14]尚書僕射劉子直、吏部尚書崔朏等。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Li Ping took Xindu; Yuan Yu fled north. Those Yuan Yu had appointed—Jizhou Governor Wei Chao, Right Guard General Mu Ya, [14] Vice Minister of State Liu Zizhi, and Minister of Personnel Cui Fei—were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Li Ping took Xindu and Yuan Yu fled north. Li Ping beheaded those Yuan Yu had appointed—Jizhou Governor Wei Chao, Right Guard General Mu Ya, [14] Vice Minister of State Liu Zizhi, and Minister of Personnel Cui Fei.

sentences.zh: 統軍叔孫頭執愉送信都。

translations.literal: Commander-in-Chief Sun Tou captured Yuan Yu and sent him to Xindu.
translations.idiomatic: Commander-in-Chief Sun Tou captured Yuan Yu and sent him to Xindu.

sentences.zh: 羣臣請誅愉，帝弗許，詔送京師。

translations.literal: The assembled ministers asked that Yuan Yu be executed; the emperor did not consent and ordered him sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The assembled ministers asked that Yuan Yu be executed; the emperor did not consent and ordered him sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 冀州平。

translations.literal: Jizhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Jizhou was pacified.

sentences.zh: 庚子，郢州司馬彭珍、治中督榮祖等謀叛，潛引蕭衍眾入義陽，郢州刺史婁悅擊走之。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Yingzhou Chief Clerk Peng Zhen, Administrator-in-Chief Du Rongzu, and others plotted rebellion and secretly brought Xiao Yan's troops into Yiyang; Yingzhou Inspector Lou Yue attacked and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Yingzhou Chief Clerk Peng Zhen, Administrator-in-Chief Du Rongzu, and others plotted rebellion and secretly brought Xiao Yan's troops into Yiyang; Yingzhou Inspector Lou Yue attacked and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 詔將軍胡季智、屈祖等南赴義陽。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Generals Hu Jizhi, Qu Zu, and others south to Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Generals Hu Jizhi, Qu Zu, and others south to Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 三關戍主侯登、陽鳳省等以城南叛，婁悅嬰城固守。

translations.literal: Garrison commanders of the Three Passes Hou Deng, Yang Fengsheng, and others rebelled with the south of the city; Lou Yue ringed the city and held firm.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison commanders of the Three Passes Hou Deng, Yang Fengsheng, and others rebelled with the south of the city; Lou Yue ringed the city and held firm.

sentences.zh: 遣中山王英督步騎三萬以赴之。

translations.literal: Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying was sent to command thirty thousand foot and horse to go to their relief.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying was sent to command thirty thousand foot and horse to go to their relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳，詔復故北海王詳本封，葬以王禮。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, on dingsi day, an edict restored the former Prince of Beihai Yuan Xiang's original enfeoffment and buried him with princely rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingsi day, an edict restored the former Prince of Beihai Yuan Xiang's original enfeoffment and buried him with princely rites.

sentences.zh: 豫州彭城人白早生殺刺史司馬悅，[15]據城南叛，蕭衍遣將齊苟仁等四將以助之。

translations.literal: Bai Zaosheng of Pengcheng in Yuzhou killed Inspector Sima Yue [15] and rebelled with the south of the city; Xiao Yan sent the generals Qi Gouren and three others to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Zaosheng of Pengcheng in Yuzhou killed Inspector Sima Yue [15] and rebelled with the south of the city; Xiao Yan sent Generals Qi Gouren and three others to assist him.

sentences.zh: 詔尚書邢巒行豫州事，督將軍崔暹率騎討之。

translations.literal: An edict named Minister of State Xing Luan acting commissioner for Yuzhou and ordered General Cui Xuan to lead cavalry to campaign against them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict named Minister of State Xing Luan acting commissioner for Yuzhou and ordered General Cui Xuan to lead cavalry to campaign against them.

sentences.zh: 丙子，邢巒大破早生及苟仁軍於鮑口。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, Xing Luan greatly defeated the armies of Bai Zaosheng and Gouren at Baokou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Xing Luan greatly defeated the armies of Bai Zaosheng and Gouren at Baokou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑前宿豫戍主成安樂子景儁殺宿豫戍主嚴仲賢，以城南叛。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, previously the Suyu garrison commander Cheng Anle's son Jing Jun had killed Suyu Garrison Commander Yan Zhongxian and rebelled with the south of the city.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, previously the Suyu garrison commander Cheng Anle's son Jing Jun had killed Suyu Garrison Commander Yan Zhongxian and rebelled with the south of the city.

sentences.zh: 十有一月庚寅，詔安東將軍楊椿率眾四萬攻宿豫。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on gengyin day, an edict ordered General Who Pacifies the East Yang Chun to lead forty thousand men to attack Suyu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengyin day, an edict ordered General Who Pacifies the East Yang Chun to lead forty thousand men to attack Suyu.

sentences.zh: 十有二月己未，邢巒克懸瓠，斬白早生，擒齊苟仁等，俘蕭衍卒三千餘人，分賜王公已下。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jiwei day, Xing Luan took Xuanhu, beheaded Bai Zaosheng, captured Qi Gouren and others, and took more than three thousand of Xiao Yan's soldiers captive; they were distributed among kings, dukes, and those below.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiwei day, Xing Luan took Xuanhu, beheaded Bai Zaosheng, captured Qi Gouren and others, and took more than three thousand of Xiao Yan's soldiers captive; they were distributed among kings, dukes, and those below.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，中山王英破衍將於楚城，擒衍寧朔將軍張疑等。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying defeated Yan's generals at Chucheng and captured Yan's General Who Calms the North Zhang Yi and others.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying defeated Xiao Yan's generals at Chucheng and captured his General Who Calms the North Zhang Yi and others.

sentences.zh: [16]郢州刺史婁悅破衍將馬仙琕於金山。

translations.literal: [16] Yingzhou Inspector Lou Yue defeated Yan's general Ma Xianbi at Jinshan.
translations.idiomatic: [16] Yingzhou Inspector Lou Yue defeated Xiao Yan's general Ma Xianbi at Jinshan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，漢東蠻民一萬七千戶相率內附。

translations.literal: On renshen day, seventeen thousand households of Han River eastern Man submitted inward in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, seventeen thousand households of Han River eastern Man submitted inward in succession.

sentences.zh: 丙子，高麗國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, the state of Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the state of Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高昌國王麴嘉遣其兄子私署左衞將軍孝亮奉表來朝，因求內徙，乞師迎接。

translations.literal: That year, King Qu Jia of Gaochang sent his elder brother's son, the self-appointed Left Guard General Xiaoliang, with a memorial to court, asking to move inward and begging troops to receive them.
translations.idiomatic: That year, King Qu Jia of Gaochang sent his elder brother's son, the self-appointed Left Guard General Xiaoliang, with a memorial to court, asking to move inward and begging troops to receive them.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月，蕭衍遣王神念寇南兗。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month: Xiao Yan sent Wang Shennian to raid Southern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, spring, first month, Xiao Yan sent Wang Shennian to raid Southern Yan.

sentences.zh: 詔輔國將軍長孫稚假平南將軍為都督，率統軍邴虬等五軍以討之。

translations.literal: An edict named Assistant General Changsun Zhi acting General Who Pacifies the South as commander-in-chief and ordered Commanders-in-Chief Bing Qiu and five armies to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict named Assistant General Changsun Zhi acting general who pacifies the south as commander-in-chief and ordered Commanders-in-Chief Bing Qiu and five armies to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，胡密、步就磨、忸密、槃是、悉萬斤、辛豆那、越拔忸諸國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Humu, Buduomo, Niumi, Panshi, Simowanjin, Xindouna, Yuebaniu, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Humu, Buduomo, Niumi, Panshi, Simowanjin, Xindouna, Yuebaniu, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，嚈噠、薄知國遣使來朝，貢白象一。

translations.literal: On renchen day, the Hephthalites and Bozhi sent envoys to court and presented one white elephant.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, the Hephthalites and Bozhi sent envoys to court and presented one white elephant.

sentences.zh: 乙未，高昌國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, the state of Gaochang sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the state of Gaochang sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙申，中山王英進逼蕭衍長薄戍，戊戌，宵潰，殺傷千數。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying pressed Xiao Yan's Changbo garrison; on wuxu day it broke at night; killed and wounded numbered in the thousands.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying pressed Xiao Yan's Changbo garrison; on wuxu day it broke at night; killed and wounded numbered in the thousands.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，拔武陽關，擒衍雲騎將軍、松滋縣開國侯馬廣，冠軍將軍、遷陵縣開國子彭瓫生，驍騎將軍、當陽縣開國伯徐元季等二十六將，俘獲七千餘人。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Wuyang Pass was taken; Yan's Cloud Cavalry General and Baron of Songzi County Ma Guang, Champion General and Viscount of Qianling County Peng Fusheng, Valiant Cavalry General and Baron of Dangyang County Xu Yuanji, and twenty-six other generals were captured; captives exceeded seven thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Wuyang Pass was taken; Xiao Yan's cloud cavalry general and baron of Songzi County Ma Guang, champion general and viscount of Qianling County Peng Fusheng, valiant cavalry general and baron of Dangyang County Xu Yuanji, and twenty-six other generals were captured; captives exceeded seven thousand.

sentences.zh: 進攻黃峴、西關。

translations.literal: They pressed the attack on Huangxian and Xiguan.
translations.idiomatic: They pressed the attack on Huangxian and Xiguan.

sentences.zh: 衍將馬仙琕棄西關，李元履棄黃峴遁走。

translations.literal: Yan's general Ma Xianbi abandoned Xiguan; Li Yuanlu abandoned Huangxian and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yan's general Ma Xianbi abandoned Xiguan; Li Yuanlu abandoned Huangxian and fled.

sentences.zh: 是月，涇州沙門劉慧汪聚眾反。

translations.literal: That month, the monk Liu Huiwang of Jingzhou gathered a crowd and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the monk Liu Huiwang of Jingzhou gathered a crowd and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 詔華州刺史奚康生討之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Huazhou Inspector Xi Kangsheng to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Huazhou Inspector Xi Kangsheng to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，詔曰：「比軍役頻興，仗多毀敗，在庫戎器，見有無幾。

translations.literal: Second month, on yimao day, an edict stated: "Lately military campaigns have arisen in succession; many weapons are ruined and broken, and the armaments in store are now few indeed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yimao day, an edict stated, "Lately military campaigns have arisen in succession; many weapons are ruined and broken, and the armaments in store are now few indeed.

sentences.zh: 安不忘危，古人所戒，五兵之器，事須充積，經造既殷，非眾莫舉。

translations.literal: In security do not forget danger—so the ancients warned; the five weapons must be fully stocked, and once manufacture is undertaken it is heavy work that none but the multitude can undertake.
translations.idiomatic: In security do not forget danger—so the ancients warned; the five weapons must be fully stocked, and once manufacture is undertaken it is heavy work that none but the multitude can undertake.

sentences.zh: 今可量造四萬人雜仗。

translations.literal: Now measure and manufacture forty thousand men's mixed arms."
translations.idiomatic: Now measure and manufacture forty thousand men's mixed arms."

sentences.zh: 」三月癸未，磨豆羅、阿曜社蘇突闍、地伏羅諸國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Third month, on guiwei day, Madura, Ayasosutuojian, and Divoluo and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guiwei day, Madura, Ayasosutuojian, and Divoluo and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，詔以武川鎮飢，開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiyou day, an edict ordered that because Wuchuan Garrison was in famine, granaries were to be opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiyou day, an edict ordered that because Wuchuan Garrison was in famine, granaries were to be opened for relief.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔曰：「聖人濟世，隨物汙隆，或正或權，理無恒在。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, an edict stated: "The sage succors the age, following things in decline or ascent; sometimes upright, sometimes expedient—there is no constant that always holds.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, an edict stated, "The sage succors the age, following things in decline or ascent; sometimes upright, sometimes expedient—there is no constant that always holds.

sentences.zh: 先朝以雲駕甫遷，嵩基始構，河洛民庶，徙舊未安，代來新宅，尚不能就。

translations.literal: The former court, when the cloud carriage had just moved and the Song foundation was first raised, moved the people of the Yellow and Luo but the old had not yet been settled; the new dwellings of Dai had still not been completed.
translations.idiomatic: The former court, when the cloud carriage had just moved and the Song foundation was first raised, moved the people of the Yellow and Luo but the old had not yet been settled; the new dwellings of Dai had still not been completed.

sentences.zh: 伊闕西南，羣蠻填聚；

translations.literal: Southwest of Yique, the southern barbarians were packed in crowds;
translations.idiomatic: Southwest of Yique, the southern barbarians were packed in crowds;

sentences.zh: 沔陽賊城，連邑作戍；

translations.literal: at Mianyang the rebel cities linked towns into garrisons;
translations.idiomatic: at Mianyang the rebel cities linked towns into garrisons;

sentences.zh: 蠢爾愚巴，心未純款。

translations.literal: those foolish Ba, stupid in heart, had not yet given pure allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: those foolish Ba, stupid in heart, had not yet given pure allegiance.

sentences.zh: 故暫抑造育之仁，權緩肅姦之法。

translations.literal: Therefore for a time We suppressed the benevolence that nurtures life and temporarily relaxed the laws that purge wickedness.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore for a time we suppressed the benevolence that nurtures life and temporarily relaxed the laws that purge wickedness.

sentences.zh: 今京師天固，與昔不同。

translations.literal: Now the capital is heaven-fortified and unlike the past.
translations.idiomatic: Now the capital is heaven-fortified and unlike the past.

sentences.zh: 楊郢荊益，皆悉我有；

translations.literal: Yang, Ying, Jing, and Yi are all fully Ours;
translations.idiomatic: Yang, Ying, Jing, and Yi are all fully ours;

sentences.zh: 保險諸蠻，罔不歸附；

translations.literal: the various barbarians who hold defiles—none fail to submit;
translations.idiomatic: the various barbarians who hold defiles—none fail to submit;

sentences.zh: 商洛民情，誠倍往日。

translations.literal: the hearts of the people of Shang and Luo are truly twice what they were in former days.
translations.idiomatic: the hearts of the people of Shang and Luo are truly twice what they were in former days.

sentences.zh: 唯樊襄已南，仁乖道政，被拘隔化，非民之咎。

translations.literal: Only south of Fan and Xiang has benevolence departed from the Way and government gone awry; held back from transformation, it is not the people's fault.
translations.idiomatic: Only south of Fan and Xiang has benevolence departed from the Way and government gone awry; held back from transformation, it is not the people's fault.

sentences.zh: 而無賴之徒，輕相劫掠，屠害良善，離人父兄。

translations.literal: Yet worthless fellows lightly raid and plunder, slaughter the good, and tear fathers from sons and brothers apart.
translations.idiomatic: Yet worthless fellows lightly raid and plunder, slaughter the good, and tear fathers from sons and brothers apart.

sentences.zh: 衍之為酷，實亦深矣。

translations.literal: The cruelty of Yan is indeed deep.
translations.idiomatic: The cruelty of Xiao Yan is indeed deep.

sentences.zh: 便可放彼掠民，示其大惠，捨此殘賊，未令之愆。

translations.literal: Now release the people he has plundered and show them great favor; set aside these remnant bandits and their unfulfilled guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Now release the people he has plundered and show them great favor; set aside these remnant bandits and their unfulfilled guilt.

sentences.zh: 并敕緣邊州鎮，自今已後，不聽境外寇盜，犯者罪同境內。

translations.literal: Also order the frontier provinces and garrisons: from now on they are not to hear of raiding and robbery beyond the border; offenders are guilty as if within the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Also order the frontier provinces and garrisons: from now on they are not to hear of raiding and robbery beyond the border; offenders are guilty as if within the realm.

sentences.zh: 若州鎮主將，知容不糾，坐之如律。

translations.literal: If provincial or garrison commanders and chief generals know and tolerate without impeachment, they are to be punished according to law."
translations.idiomatic: If provincial or garrison commanders and chief generals know and tolerate without impeachment, they are to be punished according to law."

sentences.zh: 」五月，高麗國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Fifth month: the state of Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the state of Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，帝以旱故，減膳徹懸，禁斷屠殺。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, because of drought the emperor reduced his meals, withdrew suspended music, and forbade slaughter.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, because of drought the emperor reduced his meals, withdrew suspended music, and forbade slaughter.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，幸華林都亭，親錄囚徒，犯死罪已下降一等。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, he visited the Hualin Capital Pavilion and personally examined prisoners; those guilty of capital crimes and below were reduced one degree.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, he visited the Hualin Capital Pavilion and personally examined prisoners; those guilty of capital crimes and below were reduced one degree.

sentences.zh: 六月，高昌國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Sixth month: the state of Gaochang sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the state of Gaochang sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔曰：「江海方同，車書宜一，諸州軌轍南北不等。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, an edict stated: "Within the four seas the rivers and sea are one; carts and writing should be unified, yet the wheel tracks of the provinces north and south are not equal.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, an edict stated, "Within the four seas the rivers and sea are one; carts and writing should be unified, yet the wheel tracks of the provinces north and south are not equal.

sentences.zh: 今可申敕四方，使遠近無二。」

translations.literal: Now proclaim and order the four quarters so that far and near are not two."
translations.idiomatic: Now proclaim and order the four quarters so that far and near are not two."

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，契丹國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on guiwei day, the state of Khitan sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiwei day, the state of Khitan sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未，鄧至國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on dingwei day, the state of Dengzhi sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingwei day, the state of Dengzhi sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以鄧至國世子像覽蹄為其國王。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Xianglanqi, heir of the state of Dengzhi, was installed as its king.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Xianglanqi, heir of the state of Dengzhi, was installed as its king.

sentences.zh: 高昌、勿吉、庫莫奚諸國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Gaochang, Wuji, Kumo Xi, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Gaochang, Wuji, Kumo Xi, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳，封故北海王子顥為北海王。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on xinsi day, the former Prince of Beihai's son Hao was enfeoffed Prince of Beihai.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinsi day, the former Prince of Beihai's son Hao was enfeoffed Prince of Beihai.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔定諸門闥名。

translations.literal: On renwu day, an edict fixed the names of the various gates and doorways.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, an edict fixed the names of the various gates and doorways.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸丑，以司空、廣陽王嘉為司徒。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, on guichou day, Minister of Works and Prince of Guangyang Yuan Jia was made Minister of State.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guichou day, Minister of Works Yuan Jia, Prince of Guangyang, was made minister of state.

sentences.zh: 庚午，郢州獻七寶牀，詔不納。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, Yingzhou presented a seven-jewel couch; an edict declined to accept it.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Yingzhou presented a seven-jewel couch; an edict declined to accept it.

sentences.zh: 十有一月甲申，詔禁屠殺含孕，以為永制。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiashen day, an edict forbade slaughter of pregnant animals as a permanent statute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiashen day, an edict forbade slaughter of pregnant animals as a permanent statute.

sentences.zh: 己丑，帝於式乾殿為諸僧、朝臣講維摩詰經。

translations.literal: On jichou day, the emperor in the Shiqian Hall lectured on the Vimalakirti Sutra for the various monks and court ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, the emperor in the Shiqian Hall lectured on the Vimalakirti Sutra for the various monks and court ministers.

sentences.zh: 十有二月，詔曰：「五等諸侯，比無選式。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, an edict stated: "The five ranks of feudal lords have until now had no standard for selection.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month an edict stated, "The five ranks of feudal lords have until now had no standard for selection.

sentences.zh: 其同姓者出身：公正六下，侯從六上，伯從六下，子正七上，男正七下。

translations.literal: For those of the same surname, initial appointment: duke from sixth rank lower; marquis from sixth rank upper; earl from sixth rank lower; viscount from seventh rank upper; baron from seventh rank lower.
translations.idiomatic: For those of the same surname, initial appointment: duke from sixth rank lower; marquis from sixth rank upper; earl from sixth rank lower; viscount from seventh rank upper; baron from seventh rank lower.

sentences.zh: 異族出身：公從七上，侯從七下，伯正八上，子正八下，男從八上。

translations.literal: For different clans, initial appointment: duke from seventh rank upper; marquis from seventh rank lower; earl from eighth rank upper; viscount from eighth rank lower; baron from eighth rank upper.
translations.idiomatic: For different clans, initial appointment: duke from seventh rank upper; marquis from seventh rank lower; earl from eighth rank upper; viscount from eighth rank lower; baron from eighth rank upper.

sentences.zh: 清修出身：公從八下，侯正九上，伯正九下，子從九上，男從九下。

translations.literal: For those of pure cultivation, initial appointment: duke from eighth rank lower; marquis from ninth rank upper; earl from ninth rank lower; viscount from ninth rank upper; baron from ninth rank lower.
translations.idiomatic: For those of pure cultivation, initial appointment: duke from eighth rank lower; marquis from ninth rank upper; earl from ninth rank lower; viscount from ninth rank upper; baron from ninth rank lower.

sentences.zh: 可依此敍之。

translations.literal: They may be ranked according to this."
translations.idiomatic: They may be ranked according to this."

sentences.zh: 」疊伏羅、弗菩提、朝陁咤、波羅諸國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Diefoluo, Foputi, Chaotuozha, Poluo, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Diefoluo, Foputi, Chaotuozha, Poluo, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春二月丙午，高昌、鄧至國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Third year, second month, on bingwu day, Gaochang and Dengzhi each sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, second month, on bingwu day, Gaochang and Dengzhi each sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬子，秦州沙門劉光秀謀反。

translations.literal: On renzi day, the monk Liu Guangxiu of Qinzhou plotted rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, the monk Liu Guangxiu of Qinzhou plotted rebellion.

sentences.zh: 州郡捕斬之。

translations.literal: The province and commandery captured and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: The province and commandery captured and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，秦州隴西羌殺鎮將趙儁，阻兵反叛。

translations.literal: On guihai day, the Longxi Qiang of Qinzhou killed Garrison Commander Zhao Jun and raised troops in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, the Longxi Qiang of Qinzhou killed Garrison Commander Zhao Jun and raised troops in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 州軍討平之。

translations.literal: The provincial army campaigned and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: The provincial army campaigned and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，皇子生，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Third month, on bingxu day, a prince was born; a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingxu day, a prince was born; a great amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 高麗、吐谷渾、宕昌諸國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Goryeo, Tuyuhun, Dangchang, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo, Tuyuhun, Dangchang, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，平陽郡之禽昌、襄陵二縣大疫，自正月至此月，死者二千七百三十人。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: in Qinchang and Xiangling counties of Pingyang commandery a great epidemic broke out; from the first month to this month, two thousand seven hundred thirty persons died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, in Qinchang and Xiangling counties of Pingyang commandery a great epidemic broke out; from the first month to this month, two thousand seven hundred thirty persons died.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥，詔以冀定二州旱儉，開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on dinghai day, an edict ordered that because Ji and Ding provinces were in drought and famine, granaries were to be opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dinghai day, an edict ordered that because Ji and Ding provinces were in drought and famine, granaries were to be opened for relief.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，詔重求遺書於天下。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on renyin day, an edict again sought lost books throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renyin day, an edict again sought lost books throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，名皇子曰詡。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the prince was named Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, the prince was named Xu.

sentences.zh: 閏月己亥，吐谷渾、高麗、契丹諸國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on jihai day, Tuyuhun, Goryeo, Khitan, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jihai day, Tuyuhun, Goryeo, Khitan, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，吐谷渾國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on jiwei day, the state of Tuyuhun sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiwei day, the state of Tuyuhun sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，勿吉國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on jimao day, the state of Wuji sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jimao day, the state of Wuji sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，烏萇、伽秀沙尼諸國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on renyin day, Uddiyana, Gaxiushani, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renyin day, Uddiyana, Gaxiushani, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，高車別帥可略汗等率眾一千七百內屬。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, the detached commander of Gaoche Keluehan and others led more than one thousand seven hundred men to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the detached commander of Gaoche Keluehan and others led more than one thousand seven hundred men to submit inward.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，中山王英薨。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, on xinmao day, Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinmao day, Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying died.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔曰：「朕乘乾御曆，年周一紀，而道謝擊壤，教慚刑厝。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, an edict stated: "We have borne the succession of Heaven and held the calendar for a full cycle, yet the Way falls short of the age of free tillage and teaching lags behind the age when punishments were set aside.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, an edict stated, "We have borne the succession of Heaven and held the calendar for a full cycle, yet the Way falls short of the age of free tillage and teaching lags behind the age when punishments were set aside.

sentences.zh: 至於下民之煢鰥疾苦，心常愍之，此而不恤，豈為民父母之意也。

translations.literal: As for the solitary and suffering illness of the people below, Our heart constantly pities them; if We do not succor this, how is that the mind of parents to the people?"
translations.idiomatic: As for the solitary and suffering illness of the people below, our heart constantly pities them; if we do not succor this, how is that the mind of parents to the people?"

sentences.zh: 可敕太常於閑敞之處，別立一館，使京畿內外疾病之徒，咸令居處。

translations.literal: Order the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to establish separately, in an open and spacious place, one lodge so that the sick within and without the capital districts may all be lodged there.
translations.idiomatic: Order the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to establish separately, in an open and spacious place, one lodge so that the sick within and without the capital districts may all be lodged there.

sentences.zh: 嚴敕醫署，分師療治，考其能否，而行賞罰。

translations.literal: Strictly order the medical office to assign masters for treatment, examine their ability, and apply rewards and punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Strictly order the medical office to assign masters for treatment, examine their ability, and apply rewards and punishments.

sentences.zh: 雖齡數有期，修短分定，然三疾不同，[17]或賴針石，庶秦扁之言，理驗今日。

translations.literal: Though years and span have their term and long and short are allotted by fate, yet the three illnesses differ [17] and some may rely on needle and stone; perhaps the words of Qin Yue and Bian Que may be tested in truth today.
translations.idiomatic: Though years and span have their term and long and short are allotted by fate, yet the three illnesses differ [17] and some may rely on needle and stone; perhaps the words of Qin Yue and Bian Que may be tested in truth today.

sentences.zh: 又經方浩博，流傳處廣，應病投藥，卒難窮究。

translations.literal: Also, medical prescriptions are vast and spread widely; applying medicine to fit the illness is hard to exhaust in inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: Also, medical prescriptions are vast and spread widely; applying medicine to fit the illness is hard to exhaust in inquiry.

sentences.zh: 更令有司，集諸醫工，尋篇推簡，務存精要，取三十餘卷，以班九服，郡縣備寫，布下鄉邑，使知救患之術耳。

translations.literal: Further order the relevant offices to gather all medical craftsmen, search the texts and distill them, striving to preserve essentials, take more than thirty scrolls, and distribute them to the nine domains; commanderies and counties are to copy them fully and send them down to townships so that people may know the arts of saving distress."
translations.idiomatic: Further order the relevant offices to gather all medical craftsmen, search the texts and distill them, striving to preserve essentials, take more than thirty scrolls, and distribute them to the nine domains; commanderies and counties are to copy them fully and send them down to townships so that people may know the arts of saving distress."

sentences.zh: 」戊戌，高車，龜茲、難地、那竭、庫莫奚等諸國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, Gaoche, Kucha, Nandi, Najie, Kumo Xi, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Gaoche, Kucha, Nandi, Najie, Kumo Xi, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 十有二月己卯，高麗、比沙杖國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jimao day, Goryeo and Bishazhang sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jimao day, Goryeo and Bishazhang sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，江陽王繼坐事除名。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, Yuan Ji, Prince of Jiangyang, was struck from the registers for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Yuan Ji, Prince of Jiangyang, was struck from the registers for an offense.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔於青州立高祖廟。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, an edict established the High Ancestor's temple in Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, an edict established the High Ancestor's temple in Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 殿中侍御史王敞謀反伏誅。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Censor Wang Chang plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Censor Wang Chang plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，琅邪民王萬壽斬蕭衍輔國將軍、琅邪東莞二郡太守劉晣首，以朐山來降。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: Wang Wanshou of Langya beheaded Xiao Yan's Assistant General and Administrator of Langya and Dongguan Liu Xi and came to submit with Qushan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, Wang Wanshou of Langya beheaded Xiao Yan's assistant general and administrator of Langya and Dongguan Liu Xi and came to submit with Qushan.

sentences.zh: 徐州刺史盧昶遣琅邪戍主傅文驥率眾據之。

translations.literal: Xuzhou Inspector Lu Chang sent Langya Garrison Commander Fu Wenji to lead troops and hold it.
translations.idiomatic: Xuzhou Inspector Lu Chang sent Langya Garrison Commander Fu Wenji to lead troops and hold it.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，薛和大破山胡。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, Xue He greatly defeated the Shanhu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Xue He greatly defeated the Shanhu.

sentences.zh: 蕭衍遣其鎮北將軍張稷及馬仙琕寇朐山。

translations.literal: Xiao Yan sent his General Who Pacifies the North Zhang Ji and Ma Xianbi to raid Qushan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yan sent his General Who Pacifies the North Zhang Ji and Ma Xianbi to raid Qushan.

sentences.zh: 詔盧昶率眾赴之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Lu Chang to lead troops to go to their relief.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Lu Chang to lead troops to go to their relief.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥遷代京銅龍置天淵池。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jihai day, the bronze dragon of the relocated capital was moved to the Celestial Abyss Pool.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jihai day, the bronze dragon of the relocated capital was moved to the Celestial Abyss Pool.

sentences.zh: [19]丙辰，詔禁天文之學。

translations.literal: [19] On bingchen day, an edict forbade the study of astronomy.
translations.idiomatic: [19] On bingchen day, an edict forbade the study of astronomy.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，乾達、阿婆羅、達舍、越伽使密、不流沙諸國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on yihai day, Gandhara, Apoluo, Dashe, Yueqashimi, and Bushali and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yihai day, Gandhara, Apoluo, Dashe, Yueqashimi, and Bushali and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉，吐谷渾、契丹國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on xinyou day, Tuyuhun and Khitan each sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinyou day, Tuyuhun and Khitan each sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未，阿婆羅、達舍、越伽使密、不流沙等諸國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on xinwei day, Apoluo, Dashe, Yueqashimi, Bushali, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinwei day, Apoluo, Dashe, Yueqashimi, Bushali, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，勿吉國獻楛矢。

translations.literal: On guisi day, the state of Wuji presented hardwood arrows.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, the state of Wuji presented hardwood arrows.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，蕭衍九山戍主苟仁以戍來降。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jiayin day, Xiao Yan's Jiushan Garrison Commander Gou Ren came to submit with the garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiayin day, Xiao Yan's Jiushan Garrison Commander Gou Ren came to submit with the garrison.

sentences.zh: [20]嚈噠、朱居槃、波羅、莫伽陁、移婆僕羅、俱薩羅、舍彌、羅樂陁等諸國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: [20] The Hephthalites, Zhujupan, Poluo, Mojiatuo, Yibopulu, Jusala, Shemi, Luoyuetuo, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: [20] The Hephthalites, Zhujupan, Poluo, Mojiatuo, Yibopulu, Jusala, Shemi, Luoyuetuo, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁丑，婆比幡彌、烏萇、比地、乾達等諸國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, on dingchou day, Bipofanmi, Uddiyana, Bidi, Gandhara, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingchou day, Bipofanmi, Uddiyana, Bidi, Gandhara, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 十有一月甲午，宕昌國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiawu day, the state of Dangchang sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiawu day, the state of Dangchang sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔李崇、奚康生等治兵壽春，以分朐山之寇。

translations.literal: On jihai day, an edict ordered Li Chong, Xi Kangsheng, and others to drill troops at Shouchun to divide the raiders at Qushan.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, an edict ordered Li Chong, Xi Kangsheng, and others to drill troops at Shouchun to divide the raiders at Qushan.

sentences.zh: 戊申，難地、伏羅國並遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Nandi and Fulu and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Nandi and Fulu and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 朐城陷，盧昶大敗而還。

translations.literal: Qushan fell; Lu Chang was greatly defeated and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Qushan fell; Lu Chang was greatly defeated and returned.

sentences.zh: 十有二月壬申，詔曰：「進善退惡，治之通規，三載考察，政之明典。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on renshen day, an edict stated: "Advancing the good and retiring the evil is the common rule of governance; triennial examination is the bright canon of administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renshen day, an edict stated, "Advancing the good and retiring the evil is the common rule of governance; triennial examination is the bright canon of administration.

sentences.zh: 正始二年以來，于今未考，功過難齊，寧無昇降？

translations.literal: From the second year of Zhengshi until now there has been no examination—merits and faults are hard to align; can there be no promotion and demotion?"
translations.idiomatic: From the second year of Zhengshi until now there has been no examination—merits and faults are hard to align; can there be no promotion and demotion?"

sentences.zh: 從景明二年至永平四年，通考以聞。

translations.literal: From the second year of Jingming through the fourth year of Yongping, conduct a comprehensive examination and report.
translations.idiomatic: From the second year of Jingming through the fourth year of Yongping, conduct a comprehensive examination and report.

sentences.zh: 」戊子，大羅汗、婆來伽國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Darohan and Bolaijia sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Darohan and Bolaijia sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 延昌元年春正月乙巳，以頻水旱，百姓饑弊，分遣使者開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: First year of Yanzhang, spring, first month, on yisi day, because of repeated flood and drought and the people's hunger and distress, envoys were separately dispatched to open granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yanzhang, spring, first month, on yisi day, because of repeated flood and drought and the people's hunger and distress, envoys were separately dispatched to open granaries for relief.

sentences.zh: 戊申，疏勒國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: On wushen day, the state of Shule sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the state of Shule sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以車騎大將軍、尚書令高肇為司徒公，光祿大夫、清河王懌為司空，司州牧、廣平王懷進號驃騎大將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Minister of State Gao Zhao was made Duke of State; Palace Attendant Yuan Yi, Prince of Qinghe, was made Minister of Works; Sizhou Governor Yuan Huai, Prince of Guangping, was advanced to General Who Conquers on Horseback with ritual equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Minister of State Gao Zhao was made duke of state; Palace Attendant Yuan Yi, Prince of Qinghe, was made minister of works; Sizhou Governor Yuan Huai, Prince of Guangping, was advanced to general who conquers on horseback with ritual equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯朔，[21]渴槃陁國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Third month, on xinmao day, the new moon, [21] the state of Kapisi sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinmao day, the new moon, [21] the state of Kapisi sent envoys presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲午，州郡十一大水，詔開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, eleven provinces and commanderies suffered great flood; an edict ordered granaries opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, eleven provinces and commanderies suffered great flood; an edict ordered granaries opened for relief.

sentences.zh: 以京師穀貴，出倉粟八十萬石以賑貧者。

translations.literal: Because grain in the capital was dear, eight hundred thousand hu of stored grain were released to relieve the poor.
translations.idiomatic: Because grain in the capital was dear, eight hundred thousand hu of stored grain were released to relieve the poor.

sentences.zh: 己未，安樂王詮薨。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Yuan Quan, Prince of Anle, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Yuan Quan, Prince of Anle, died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，詔以旱故，食粟之畜皆斷之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: an edict ordered that because of drought, all grain-eating livestock were to be cut off.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer an edict ordered that because of drought, all grain-eating livestock were to be cut off.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔曰：「遷京嵩縣，年將二紀，虎闈闕唱演之音，四門絕講誦之業，博士端然，虛祿歲祀，貴遊之冑，歎同子衿，靖言念之，有兼愧慨。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, an edict stated: "The move of the capital to Song County is nearly two cycles; at the Tiger Enclosure the sounds of chanting are stilled and at the Four Gates the work of lecturing and reciting is cut off—the erudites sit upright, receiving empty salaries year after year; the noble scions sigh like Zijin; thinking on this quietly, We are doubly ashamed and indignant.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, an edict stated, "The move of the capital to Song County is nearly two cycles; at the Tiger Enclosure the sounds of chanting are stilled and at the Four Gates the work of lecturing and reciting is cut off—the erudites sit upright, receiving empty salaries year after year; the noble scions sigh like Zijin; thinking on this quietly, we are doubly ashamed and indignant.

sentences.zh: 可嚴敕有司，國子學孟冬使成，太學、四門明年暮春令就。

translations.literal: Strictly order the relevant offices: the Directorate of Education is to be completed in mid-winter; the Imperial Academy and Four Gates are to be ready in late spring of next year."
translations.idiomatic: Strictly order the relevant offices: the Directorate of Education is to be completed in mid-winter; the Imperial Academy and Four Gates are to be ready in late spring of next year."

sentences.zh: 」戊辰，以旱，詔尚書與羣司鞠理獄訟，詔河北民就穀燕恒二州。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, because of drought, an edict ordered the Ministry of State and the various offices to examine prison cases; an edict ordered the people of Hebei to go where grain was available in Yan and Heng provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, because of drought, an edict ordered the Ministry of State and the various offices to examine prison cases; an edict ordered the people of Hebei to go where grain was available in Yan and Heng provinces.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔饑民就穀六鎮。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, an edict ordered hungry people to go where grain was available at the Six Garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, an edict ordered hungry people to go where grain was available at the Six Garrisons.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，帝以旱故，減膳撤懸。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, because of drought the emperor reduced his meals and withdrew suspended music.

translations.idiomatic: From the second month there was no rain until this last day of the month.

translations.literal: Sixth month, on renshen day, timely rain fell in great abundance.

translations.literal: On wuyin day, the prohibition on brood mares in Henan was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the prohibition on brood mares in Henan was lifted.

translations.literal: On jimao day, an edict stated: "Last year there was flood disaster; this spring scorching drought; the people are hungry and in distress and have nowhere to lodge their lives; though the silkworm month has passed, they cannot nurture the harvest.

translations.literal: On gengchen day, an edict released five hundred thousand hu of grain from the great storehouse to relieve hungry people in the capital and in provinces and commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, an edict released five hundred thousand hu of grain from the great storehouse to relieve hungry people in the capital and in provinces and commanderies.

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn: Tuyuhun and Khitan each sent envoys presenting tribute.

translations.literal: On dinghai day, the state of Wuji presented hardwood arrows.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the state of Wuji presented hardwood arrows.

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, on yihai day, Prince Xu was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yihai day, Prince Xu was installed as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 是月，嚈噠、于闐、高昌及庫莫奚諸國並遣使朝獻。

translations.idiomatic: That month, the Hephthalites, Khotan, Gaochang, Kumo Xi, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on bingshen day, an edict stated: "We have received Heaven's blessing and rule the imperial realm; the crown prince's person draws on numinous clarity and has just raised the palace of splendor; when the two luminaries are in accord the three goods are well joined—it is fitting that favor soak the whole realm and glory spread to all descendants.

translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the system of slaves and bondservants was fixed, with Jingming as the cutoff.

translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingyin day, the state of Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.

translations.idiomatic: That summer thirteen provinces and commanderies suffered great flood.

sentences.zh: 按卷六五邢巒傳稱「蕭衍輔國將軍李畎戍石同」。

translations.literal: Comment: juan 65 Biography of Xing Luan states "Xiao Yan's General Who Assists the State Li Quan garrisoned Shitong."
translations.idiomatic: Comment: juan 65 Biography of Xing Luan states "Xiao Yan's General Who Assists the State Li Quan garrisoned Shitong."

sentences.zh: 卷七一李苗傳稱苗叔父略為蕭衍寧州刺史，曾拒王足於涪。

translations.literal: Juan 71 Biography of Li Miao states Miao's uncle Lue was Inspector of Ningzhou under Xiao Yan and once resisted Wang Zu at Fu.
translations.idiomatic: Juan 71 Biography of Li Miao states Miao's uncle Lue was inspector of Ningzhou under Xiao Yan and once resisted Wang Zu at Fu.

sentences.zh: 北史卷四五李苗傳「略」作「畎」。

translations.literal: Beishi juan 45 Biography of Li Miao reads "Lue" as "Quan."
translations.idiomatic: Beishi juan 45 Biography of Li Miao reads "Lue" as "Quan."

sentences.zh: 「畋」「畎」「略」官位，雖諸傳所載各異，其人却均為在涪城一帶拒敵王足的梁將，必是一人。

translations.literal: The offices of "Tian," "Quan," and "Lue" differ in the various biographies, yet the man is the same Liang general who resisted Wang Zu in the Fucheng region—he must be one person.
translations.idiomatic: The offices of "Tian," "Quan," and "Lue" differ in the various biographies, yet the man is the same Liang general who resisted Wang Zu in the Fucheng region—he must be one person.

sentences.zh: 通鑑此條作「冠軍將軍李畎」，知本此紀，考異無文，則司馬光所見此紀，本亦作「畎」。

translations.literal: Zizhi tongjian for this entry reads "Champion General Li Quan," and since Examining Differences has no note, the annal Sima Guang saw also read "Quan."
translations.idiomatic: Zizhi tongjian for this entry reads "Champion General Li Quan," and since Examining Differences has no note, the annal Sima Guang saw also read "Quan."

sentences.zh: 此人當名「畎」，「畋」「略」都是形近而訛。

translations.literal: This man's name should be "Quan"; "Tian" and "Lue" are both errors from similar forms.
translations.idiomatic: This man's name should be "Quan"; "Tian" and "Lue" are both errors from similar forms.

sentences.zh: 又詔驃騎大將軍源懷慎 按卷四一源懷傳云本名思禮，「後賜名懷」，此作「懷慎」，疑衍「慎」字。

translations.literal: Again an edict to Valiant Cavalry Grand General Yuan Huai Shen: Comment: juan 41 Biography of Yuan Huai states his original name was Sil, "later granted the name Huai"—here it reads "Huai Shen," suspected derivation of the character "Shen."
translations.idiomatic: Again an edict to Valiant Cavalry Grand General Yuan Huai Shen: Comment: juan 41 Biography of Yuan Huai states his original name was Sil, "later granted the name Huai"—here it reads "Huai Shen," suspected derivation of the character "Shen."

sentences.zh: 但當時雙名常單稱，所見北魏墓誌中名與史傳不合者此類甚多，也可能源懷實雙名「懷慎」，今仍之。

translations.literal: But at the time double names were often called by a single part; among Northern Wei tomb epitaphs names that disagree with historical biographies are very numerous in this category; Yuan Huai may in fact have had the double name "Huai Shen"—the present text is retained.
translations.idiomatic: But at the time double names were often called by a single part; among Northern Wei tomb epitaphs names that disagree with historical biographies are very numerous; Yuan Huai may in fact have had the double name "Huai Shen"—the present text is retained.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未 北史卷四魏紀四「乙未」作「丁未」。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, yiwei day: Beishi juan 4, Wei Annals 4, reads "yiwei" as "dingwei."
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, yiwei day: Beishi juan 4, Wei Annals 4, reads "yiwei" as "dingwei."

sentences.zh: 按是年四月乙未朔，丁未乃十一日。

translations.literal: Comment: That year in the fourth month yiwei was the new moon; dingwei was the eleventh day.
translations.idiomatic: Comment: That year in the fourth month yiwei was the new moon; dingwei was the eleventh day.

sentences.zh: 若是乙未，例當下有「朔」字。

translations.literal: If it were yiwei, there should normally be the character "new moon" below.
translations.idiomatic: If it were yiwei, there should normally be the character "new moon" below.

sentences.zh: 若非「乙」為「丁」字之訛，則下脫「朔」字。

translations.literal: If "yi" is not an error for "ding," then "new moon" is missing below.
translations.idiomatic: If "yi" is not an error for "ding," then "new moon" is missing below.

sentences.zh: 衍將蕭容陷梁城 卷六五邢巒傳、卷九八蕭衍傳「容」作「密」。

translations.literal: Xiao Yan's general Xiao Rong took Liang city: juan 65 Biography of Xing Luan and juan 98 Biography of Xiao Yan read "Rong" as "Mi."
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yan's general Xiao Rong took Liang city: juan 65 Biography of Xing Luan and juan 98 Biography of Xiao Yan read "Rong" as "Mi."

sentences.zh: 按梁書卷二武帝紀天監五年五月乙亥稱「臨川王宏前軍克梁城」，「容」或「密」當是避元宏諱改。

translations.literal: Comment: Liangshu juan 2 Annals of Emperor Wu, fifth year of Tianjian, fifth month, yihai day, states "Prince of Linchuan Hong's vanguard took Liang city"; "Rong" or "Mi" was probably changed to avoid the taboo on Yuan Hong.
translations.idiomatic: Comment: Liangshu juan 2 Annals of Emperor Wu, fifth year of Tianjian, fifth month, yihai day, states "Prince of Linchuan Hong's vanguard took Liang city"; "Rong" or "Mi" was probably changed to avoid the taboo on Yuan Hong.

sentences.zh: 渴文提不那杖忸杖提等諸國 以上諸國無考，「那」下「杖」字冊府卷九六九

translations.literal: Kewenti Bunazhang Niuzhangti and other states: the above states cannot be verified; below "na" the character "zhang" in Cefu juan 969
translations.idiomatic: Kewenti Bunazhang Niuzhangti and other states: the above states cannot be verified; below "na" the character "zhang" in Cefu juan 969

sentences.zh: 〈一一三九一頁〉
作「伏」。

translations.literal: reads "fu."
translations.idiomatic: reads "fu."

sentences.zh: 右衞將軍睦雅 按「睦」非姓。

translations.literal: Right Guard General Mu Ya: Comment: "Mu" is not a surname.
translations.idiomatic: Right Guard General Mu Ya: Comment: "Mu" is not a surname.

sentences.zh: 本書卷九０逸士傳有眭夸，北齊書卷四五文苑傳有眭豫。

translations.literal: This work juan 90 Biographies of Recluses has Sui Kua; Beiqishu juan 45 Literary Grove has Sui Yu.
translations.idiomatic: This work juan 90 Biographies of Recluses has Sui Kua; Beiqishu juan 45 Literary Grove has Sui Yu.

sentences.zh: 史籍「眭」常訛作「睦」，北齊書諸本「眭豫」即訛作「睦豫」，疑這裏「睦」也是「眭」之訛。

translations.literal: In historical works "Sui" is often wrongly written "Mu"; in various editions of Beiqishu "Sui Yu" is wrongly written "Mu Yu"—here "Mu" is probably also an error for "Sui."
translations.idiomatic: In historical works "Sui" is often wrongly written "Mu"; in various editions of Beiqishu "Sui Yu" is wrongly written "Mu Yu"—here "Mu" is probably also an error for "Sui."

sentences.zh: 豫州彭城人白早生殺剌史司馬悅 冊府卷一二一

translations.literal: Yuzhou Pengcheng man Bai Zaosheng killed Inspector Sima Yue: Cefu juan 121
translations.idiomatic: Yuzhou Pengcheng man Bai Zaosheng killed Inspector Sima Yue: Cefu juan 121

sentences.zh: 〈一四五０頁〉
無「彭」字。

translations.literal: lacks the character "Peng."
translations.idiomatic: lacks the character "Peng."

sentences.zh: 按彭城不屬豫州。

translations.literal: Comment: Pengcheng did not belong to Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Comment: Pengcheng did not belong to Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 卷三七司馬悅傳、卷八七劉侯仁傳稱「城人白早生」，卷六五邢巒傳作「豫州城民白早生」，卷九八蕭衍傳作「懸瓠城民白早生」。

translations.literal: Juan 37 Biography of Sima Yue and juan 87 Biography of Liu Houren state "the city man Bai Zaosheng"; juan 65 Biography of Xing Luan reads "Yuzhou city man Bai Zaosheng"; juan 98 Biography of Xiao Yan reads "Xuangu city man Bai Zaosheng."
translations.idiomatic: Juan 37 Biography of Sima Yue and juan 87 Biography of Liu Houren state "the city man Bai Zaosheng"; juan 65 Biography of Xing Luan reads "Yuzhou city man Bai Zaosheng"; juan 98 Biography of Xiao Yan reads "Xuangu city man Bai Zaosheng."

sentences.zh: 「城人」或「城民」是當時州鎮屯戍軍所屬人口的專稱。

translations.literal: "City man" or "city people" was the special term for the population belonging to garrison troops of the time.
translations.idiomatic: "City man" or "city people" was the special term for the population belonging to garrison troops of the time.

sentences.zh: 這裏「彭」字疑衍文。

translations.literal: Here the character "Peng" is probably a superfluous derivation.
translations.idiomatic: Here the character "Peng" is probably superfluous.

sentences.zh: 擒衍寧朔將軍張疑等 卷一九下南安王楨附元英傳「張疑」作「張道凝」，又稱「斬道凝」。

translations.literal: Captured Xiao Yan's Ningshuo General Zhang Yi and others: juan 19, part 2, Biography of Prince of Nan'an Zhen, attached Biography of Yuan Ying, reads "Zhang Yi" as "Zhang Daoning," and also states "beheaded Daoning."
translations.idiomatic: Captured Xiao Yan's Ningshuo General Zhang Yi and others: juan 19, part 2, Biography of Prince of Nan'an Zhen, attached Biography of Yuan Ying, reads "Zhang Yi" as "Zhang Daoning," and also states "beheaded Daoning."

sentences.zh: 這裏「疑」當作「凝」，雙名單稱。

translations.literal: Here "Yi" should be "Ning"; a double name called by a single part.
translations.idiomatic: Here "Yi" should be "Ning"; a double name called by a single part.

sentences.zh: 「擒」「斬」未知孰是。

translations.literal: Whether "captured" or "beheaded" is correct is unknown.
translations.idiomatic: Whether "captured" or "beheaded" is correct is unknown.

sentences.zh: 然三疾不同 御覽卷一０三

translations.literal: Yet the three illnesses differ: Yulan juan 103
translations.idiomatic: Yet the three illnesses differ: Yulan juan 103

sentences.zh: 〈四九五頁〉

translations.literal: "Three" reads "six."
translations.idiomatic: "Three" reads "six."

sentences.zh: 按「三疾」見論語陽貨，指狂、矜、愚，與詔書所說疾病不同。

translations.literal: Comment: "Three illnesses" appears in Lunyu, Yang Huo, meaning madness, pride, and stupidity—different from the illnesses spoken of in the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Comment: "Three illnesses" appears in Lunyu, Yang Huo, meaning madness, pride, and stupidity—different from the illnesses spoken of in the edict.

sentences.zh: 「六疾」見左傳成元年醫和語，疑作「六」是。

translations.literal: "Six illnesses" appears in Zuozhuan, Cheng first year, in the words of the physician He—suspected that "six" is correct.
translations.idiomatic: "Six illnesses" appears in Zuozhuan, Cheng first year, in the words of the physician He—suspected that "six" is correct.

sentences.zh: 比地 冊府卷九六九

translations.literal: This region: Cefu juan 969
translations.idiomatic: This region: Cefu juan 969

sentences.zh: 〈一一三九一頁〉

translations.literal: "This" reads "north."
translations.idiomatic: "This" reads "north."

sentences.zh: 遷代京銅龍置天淵池 北史卷四、冊府卷一三

translations.literal: Moved the bronze dragon of Dai capital to the Celestial Pool: Beishi juan 4 and Cefu juan 13
translations.idiomatic: Moved the bronze dragon of Dai capital to the Celestial Pool: Beishi juan 4 and Cefu juan 13

sentences.zh: 〈一五０頁〉
「池」下有「西」字，疑脫。

translations.literal: Below "pool" is the character "west," probably missing.
translations.idiomatic: Below "pool" is the character "west," probably missing.

sentences.zh: 蕭衍九山戍主苟仁以戍來降 百衲本「仁」字空格，南本以下諸本都作「仁」，或因上文見齊苟仁而補。

translations.literal: Xiao Yan's Jiushan garrison commander Gou Ren came surrendering with the garrison: the patchwork edition leaves a blank for "Ren"; editions from the Southern edition down all read "Ren," perhaps supplied from Gou Ren seen above.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yan's Jiushan garrison commander Gou Ren came surrendering with the garrison: the patchwork edition leaves a blank for "Ren"; editions from the Southern edition down all read "Ren," perhaps supplied from Gou Ren seen above.

sentences.zh: 今姑從諸本。

translations.literal: For the present the various editions are followed.
translations.idiomatic: For the present the various editions are followed.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯朔 諸本「三月」作「二月」。

translations.literal: Third month, xinmao day, the new moon: all editions read "third month" as "second month."
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinmao day, the new moon: all editions read "third month" as "second month."

sentences.zh: 按是年二月丙辰朔，三月辛卯朔。

translations.literal: Comment: That year in the second month bingchen was the new moon; in the third month xinmao was the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Comment: That year in the second month bingchen was the new moon; in the third month xinmao was the new moon.

sentences.zh: 下記「甲午」「癸未」，乃三月四日及二十九日。

translations.literal: Below, "jiawu" and "guiwei" are the fourth and twenty-ninth days of the third month.
translations.idiomatic: Below, "jiawu" and "guiwei" are the fourth and twenty-ninth days of the third month.

sentences.zh: 下文己未稱安樂王詮死，卷一０五之二天象志二正作「延昌元年三月己未」，知「二」乃「三」之訛，今改正。

translations.literal: Below on jiwei it states Prince of Anle Quan died; juan 105, part 2, Treatise on Astral Portents 2 correctly reads "third month, jiwei, first year of Yanchang"—thus "second" is an error for "third"; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Below on jiwei it states Prince of Anle Quan died; juan 105, part 2, Treatise on Astral Portents 2 correctly reads "third month, jiwei, first year of Yanchang"—thus "second" is an error for "third"; now corrected.

sentences.zh: 民饑餓死者數萬口 卷一０五之一天象志一稱延昌二年春，「京師民饑，餓死者數萬口」。

translations.literal: The people starved and tens of thousands died of hunger: juan 105, part 1, Treatise on Astral Portents 1 states that in spring of the second year of Yanchang "the people of the capital starved; tens of thousands died of hunger."
translations.idiomatic: The people starved and tens of thousands died of hunger: juan 105, part 1, Treatise on Astral Portents 1 states that in spring of the second year of Yanchang "the people of the capital starved; tens of thousands died of hunger."

sentences.zh: 按下文即記「以絹十五萬匹賑恤河南郡饑民」，河南郡是畿郡，亦即「京師」。

translations.literal: Comment: Below it records "one hundred fifty thousand bolts of silk to relieve the famine-stricken of Henan commandery"; Henan commandery was a metropolitan commandery, that is, "the capital."
translations.idiomatic: Comment: Below it records "one hundred fifty thousand bolts of silk to relieve the famine-stricken of Henan commandery"; Henan commandery was a metropolitan commandery, that is, "the capital."

sentences.zh: 天象志記事一般即出於本紀，疑這裏「民饑」上脫「京師」二字。

translations.literal: The Treatise on Astral Portents generally draws from this annal; suspected here the two characters "capital" are missing above "the people starved."
translations.idiomatic: The Treatise on Astral Portents generally draws from this annal; suspected here the two characters "capital" are missing above "the people starved."

sentences.zh: 益州剌史傅竪眼出巴北 卷七０傅豎眼傳、卷一０五之四天象志四延昌元年條作「北巴」。

translations.literal: Yizhou Inspector Fu Shuyan marched from north of Ba: juan 70 Biography of Fu Shuyan and juan 105, part 4, Treatise on Astral Portents 4, Yanchang first year entry read "north Ba."
translations.idiomatic: Yizhou Inspector Fu Shuyan marched from north of Ba: juan 70 Biography of Fu Shuyan and juan 105, part 4, Treatise on Astral Portents 4, Yanchang first year entry read "north Ba."

sentences.zh: 按隋書卷二九地理志上巴西郡下稱「梁置南梁、北巴州」。

translations.literal: Comment: Suishu juan 29, Treatise on Geography, part 1, under Baxi commandery states "Liang established Southern Liang and North Ba provinces."
translations.idiomatic: Comment: Suishu juan 29, Treatise on Geography, part 1, under Baxi commandery states "Liang established Southern Liang and North Ba provinces."

sentences.zh: 州在今閬中縣一帶。

translations.literal: The province was in the region of present Langzhong county.
translations.idiomatic: The province was in the region of present Langzhong county.

sentences.zh: 天象志所云即出此紀，知原亦當作「北巴」，傳本誤倒，但作「巴北」亦可通，今不改。

translations.literal: What the Treatise on Astral Portents states comes from this annal; the original should also read "North Ba"; transmitted texts have the order reversed, but "north of Ba" is also intelligible—the present text is not changed.
translations.idiomatic: What the Treatise on Astral Portents states comes from this annal; the original should also read "North Ba"; transmitted texts have the order reversed, but "north of Ba" is also intelligible—the present text is not changed.
